text: शिक्षक कक्षाएँ बनाते हैं, शेक्सपियर पर प्रश्नोत्तरी और चुनौतियाँ देते हैं और अपने विद्यार्थियों की प्रगति देखते हैं।
english: Teachers create classrooms, set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Teachers create classes, give quizzes and challenges on Shakespeare and monitor their students' progress.

text: कोई कक्षा बनाएँ या किसी कक्षा में शामिल हों। शिक्षक शेक्सपियर पर प्रश्नोत्तरी और चुनौतियाँ देते हैं और अपने विद्यार्थियों की प्रगति देखते हैं।
english: Create or join a classroom. Teachers set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Create or join a class. Teachers give quizzes and challenges on Shakespeare and see their students' progress.

text: कक्षा मोड विद्यालयों के लिए बना है। आगे बढ़ने के लिए अपनी भूमिका चुनें।
english: Classroom Mode is made for schools. Choose your role to continue.
back: Classroom mode is designed for schools. Choose your role to proceed.

text: किसी मौजूदा कक्षा में शामिल होना
english: Join a classroom that already exists

text: मैं शिक्षक, प्रशिक्षक या विद्यालय प्रशासन का सदस्य हूँ, और मुझे अपने विद्यार्थियों के साथ इस सेवा के उपयोग का अधिकार है।
english: I am a teacher, an instructor or a school administrator, and I am authorised to use this with my students.
back: I am a teacher, coach or member of school administration, and I have the right to use this service with my students.

text: 18 वर्ष से कम आयु के किसी भी विद्यार्थी को जोड़ने से पहले मैं उसके माता-पिता या अभिभावक की सहमति लूँगा/लूँगी।
english: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under 18.
back: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before joining any student under 18 years of age.

text: शिक्षक के रूप में आगे बढ़ें
किसी कक्षा में शामिल होने से पहले कृपया इन बातों की पुष्टि करें:
english: Before you join a classroom, please confirm the following:
back: Please confirm the following before joining a class:

text: मेरे माता-पिता या क़ानूनी अभिभावक जानते हैं कि मैं पढ़ाई के काम के लिए Inspired Mile इस्तेमाल कर रहा/रही हूँ, और उन्होंने इसकी अनुमति दी है।
english: My parent or legal guardian knows I am using Inspired Mile for schoolwork and has given permission.
back: My parents or legal guardians know that I am using Inspired Mile for academic work, and they have given me permission.

text: मेरे शिक्षक ने मुझे कक्षा में शामिल होने का कोड दिया है।
english: My teacher has given me a join code for a classroom.
back: My teacher has given me a code to join the class.

text: मैं समझता/समझती हूँ कि मेरे शिक्षक कक्षा में मेरी प्रगति और गतिविधि देख सकते हैं।
english: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and what I do in the classroom.
back: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and activity in class.

text: विद्यार्थी के रूप में आगे बढ़ें

back: Write the class code of 6 characters.

text: आप “Verona” में शामिल हो गए हैं।

english: Enter a name for the classroom.

back: The class has been set up.

text: आप अभी किसी कक्षा में शामिल नहीं हुए हैं।
english: You have not joined a classroom yet.
back: You have not joined a class yet.

text: अपनी कक्षाएँ देखने के लिए साइन इन करें।
english: Sign in to see your classrooms.
back: Sign in to view your classes.

text: “कक्षा बनाएँ” चुनें और उसे कोई नाम दें, जैसे “कक्षा 9 (ब) – अंग्रेज़ी” या “शेक्सपियर से परिचय”। हर कक्षा को 6 अक्षरों का अपना कक्षा कोड मिलता है।
english: Choose “Create a classroom” and give it a name, such as “Period 3 English” or “Shakespeare 101”. Each classroom gets its own 6-letter join code.
back: Choose "Create Class" and give it a name, such as "Grade 9 (b) - English" or "Introduction to Shakespeare". Each class gets its own 6-character class code.

text: विद्यार्थियों को 6 अक्षरों का कोड दें। वे “मैं विद्यार्थी हूँ” चुनते हैं, सहमति की पुष्टि करते हैं और कोड लिखते हैं। ईमेल पते की ज़रूरत नहीं है।
english: Give your students the 6-letter code. They choose “I am a student”, confirm the consent and enter the code. No email address is needed.
back: Give students a 6-character code. They select “I am a student”, confirm the agreement and enter the code. No email address is required.

english: Post it on your learning platform
back: Put it on your learning platform

text: अपनी कक्षा के लिए कार्य बनाएँ: जानकारी परखने के लिए शेक्सपियर प्रश्नोत्तरी, छूटे हुए शब्द भरने वाली उद्धरण चुनौतियाँ, या रचनात्मक लेखन के लिए पदों का द्वंद्व।
english: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare trivia to check knowledge, quotation challenges to fill in the missing words, or a duel of verses for creative writing.
back: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare quizzes to check information, quotation challenges to fill in missing words, or duels of verses for creative writing.

text: प्रसिद्ध उद्धरणों में छूटे हुए शब्द भरना
english: Fill in the missing words of famous quotations
back: Fill in missing words in famous quotes

text: तीन दौर का पदों का द्वंद्व, जिसका निर्णय डिवाइस पर ही होता है
english: A three-round duel of verses, judged on the device
back: A three-round duel of positions, decided on the device

text: देखें कि हर विद्यार्थी ने क्या पूरा किया है, उसके अंक कितने हैं और उसने कौन-से कार्ड जीते हैं। डेटा कक्षा के भीतर ही रहता है: विद्यार्थी केवल अपनी प्रगति देखते हैं, और आप सबकी।
english: See what each student has completed, their scores and the cards they have earned. The data stays inside the classroom: students see their own progress, and you see everyone's.
back: See what each student has completed, how many points they have and which cards they have won. The data stays within the classroom: students only see their progress, and everyone else's.

text: विद्यार्थी की प्रगति कौन देख सकता है
english: Who can see a student's progress
back: Who can see the student's progress

text: दूसरे खिलाड़ियों के साथ शेक्सपियर के संग्रहणीय कार्ड ख़रीदें और अदला-बदली करें।
english: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.
back: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.

text: दूसरे खिलाड़ियों के साथ कार्ड ख़रीदें और अदला-बदली करें। अपने दोहरे कार्ड बिक्री के लिए रखें या वे कार्ड खोजें जो आपके पास नहीं हैं।
english: Buy and trade cards with other players. Offer your duplicates for sale, or find the cards you are missing.
back: Buy and trade cards with other players. Keep your double cards for sale or find the cards you don't have.

text: कार्ड ख़रीदने के लिए साइन इन करें।
ख़रीद लिया। कार्ड अब आपका है।
english: Bought. The card is now yours.
back: Purchased. The card is yours now.

text: अपनी लिस्टिंग देखने के लिए साइन इन करें।
english: Sign in to see your listings.
back: Sign in to view your listing.

text: लिस्ट करने के लिए कार्ड चुनें…
चाहिए वाले कार्ड (कार्ड संख्याएँ, अल्पविराम से अलग)
english: Cards wanted (card numbers, separated by commas)
back: Required cards (card numbers, separated by commas)

text: कम से कम 1 क्रेडिट की क़ीमत लिखें।
english: Enter a price of at least 1 credit.
back: Enter a value of at least 1 credit.

text: लिस्टिंग बनाने के लिए साइन इन करें।
english: Sign in to create a listing.
back: Sign in to create a listing.

text: पदों के द्वंद्व के टूर्नामेंटों में उतरें और ख़िताब के लिए खेलें।
english: Enter tournaments of verse duels and play for the title.
back: Take part in tournaments of duels of positions and play for the title.

text: आयोजित प्रतियोगिताओं में उतरें और पद्य पर अपनी पकड़ दिखाएँ। एकल उन्मूलन, राउंड-रॉबिन और भी बहुत कुछ।
english: Enter organised competitions and show your command of verse. Single elimination, round robin and more.
back: Take part in organized competitions and show your grasp on poetry. Single elimination, round-robin and more.

text: ब्रैकेट देखने के लिए कोई टूर्नामेंट चुनें।
english: Choose a tournament to see its bracket.
back: Choose a tournament to view the brackets.

text: अभी कोई टूर्नामेंट नहीं है। जल्द ही फिर देखें।
english: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.
back: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.

text: पंजीकरण के लिए साइन इन करें।
ब्रैकेट अभी तय नहीं हुआ है।
english: The bracket has not been drawn yet.
back: The bracket has not yet been determined.

text: Inspired Mile में इनाम खोलने के लिए अपने सीज़न पास का स्तर बढ़ाएँ।
english: Raise the level of your Season Pass to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.
back: Level up your Season Pass to unlock rewards in the Inspired Mile.

text: XP कमाने के लिए युद्ध, प्रश्नोत्तरी और चुनौतियाँ खेलें। हर नया स्तर कार्ड, क्रेडिट और उपाधियाँ खोलता है।
english: Play battles, trivia and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.
back: Play wars, quizzes and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.

text: अगले स्तर के लिए 150 XP बाक़ी
इस सीज़न में अभी कोई इनाम नहीं है।
english: This season has no rewards yet.
back: There are no rewards this season yet.

text: अपने सीज़न पास की प्रगति हर डिवाइस पर बनाए रखने के लिए साइन इन करें।
english: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on every device.
back: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on every device.

text: कार्डों के 3डी मॉडल देखें, गॉसियन स्प्लैट के रूप में या GLB मेश के रूप में।
english: Look at the cards' 3D models, as Gaussian splats or as GLB meshes.
back: View 3D models of the cards, as Gaussian splats or as GLB meshes.

text: अपने कार्ड 3डी मॉडल के रूप में देखें। गॉसियन स्प्लैट और GLB मेश के बीच बदलें। मॉडल घुमाने के लिए खींचें, ज़ूम के लिए स्क्रॉल करें।
english: Explore your cards as 3D models. Switch between the Gaussian splat and the GLB mesh. Drag to turn the model, scroll to zoom.
back: View your map as a 3D model. Switch between Gaussian split and GLB mesh. Drag to rotate the model, scroll to zoom.

text: 3डी व्यूअर तैयार है। कोई कार्ड चुनें।
english: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.

text: hamlet.ply लोड हो गई। घुमाने के लिए खींचें, ज़ूम के लिए स्क्रॉल करें।
english: Loaded hamlet.ply. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: hamlet.ply loaded. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.

text: hamlet.ply कम गुणवत्ता में लोड हुई। घुमाने के लिए खींचें, ज़ूम के लिए स्क्रॉल करें।
english: Loaded hamlet.ply at reduced quality. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: hamlet.ply loaded in low quality. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.

text: गति सहज बनी रहे, इसलिए चित्र की गुणवत्ता घटा दी गई है।
english: Picture quality was lowered to keep the movement smooth.
back: The image quality has been reduced to keep the speed smooth.

text: GLB मॉडल लोड हो गया: Hamlet
Hamlet के लिए कोई GLB मॉडल नहीं है।
english: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
back: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.

text: फ़ाइल में कोई मॉडल नहीं है।

english: The model could not be loaded.

text: GLB दृश्य लोड नहीं हो सका।
english: The GLB view could not be loaded.

text: Babylon.js से बनाए गए गॉसियन स्प्लैट। मॉडल की असली जैसी 3डी तस्वीर को घुमाएँ, ज़ूम करें और खिसकाएँ।
english: Gaussian splats drawn by Babylon.js. Turn, zoom and move around a lifelike 3D picture of the model.
back: Gaussian splits generated from Babylon.js. Rotate, zoom and move a real-like 3D image of the model.

text: model-viewer से दिखाया गया साधारण मेश। फ़ोन पर यह ऑगमेंटेड रियलिटी में मॉडल को आपके कमरे में रख सकता है।
english: An ordinary mesh shown with model-viewer. On a phone it can place the model in your room in augmented reality.
back: A simple mesh shown by model-viewer. On the phone it can put a model in your room in augmented reality.

text: फ़ोन पर GLB दृश्य में “एआर में देखें” पर टैप करें और कार्ड को अपने कमरे में देखें।
english: In the GLB view on a phone, tap “View in AR” to see the card in your room.
back: Tap “View in AR” in the GLB view on your phone and see the card in your room.

text: वर्चुअल रियलिटी में अपने शेक्सपियर कार्ड संग्रह के बीच घूमें।
english: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.
back: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.

text: अपने संग्रह के बीच 3डी में घूमें। यह WebXR के ज़रिए Quest 3 और Vision Pro पर चलता है, और कंप्यूटर पर माउस से।
english: Walk through your collection in 3D. It works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro through WebXR, and with a mouse on a computer.
back: Navigate through your collection in 3D. It runs on Quest 3 and Vision Pro via WebXR, and with the mouse on a computer.

text: 3डी गैलरी लोड हो गई है। चारों ओर देखने के लिए खींचें, ज़ूम के लिए स्क्रॉल करें।
english: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: 3D gallery loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom in.

text: कोई वीआर हेडसेट नहीं मिला। गैलरी 3डी में दिखाई जा रही है।
english: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.
back: No VR headset found. Gallery displayed in 3D.

text: WebXR तैयार है। “वीआर में जाएँ” दबाएँ।
back: WebXR is ready. Press “Go to VR”.

text: चित्र के कोने में दिया वीआर बटन इस्तेमाल करें।
english: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
back: Use the VR button given in the corner of the image.

text: इस डिवाइस पर WebXR उपलब्ध नहीं है। गैलरी 3डी में दिखाई जा रही है: चारों ओर देखने के लिए खींचें, ज़ूम के लिए स्क्रॉल करें।
english: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: WebXR is not available on this device. Gallery displayed in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.

text: चारों ओर देखने के लिए क्लिक करके खींचें। ज़ूम के लिए स्क्रॉल करें। किसी कार्ड को चुनने के लिए उस पर क्लिक करें।
english: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click a card to select it.
back: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom in. Click on a card to select it.

text: भीतर जाने के लिए “वीआर में जाएँ” दबाएँ। चलने और कार्ड चुनने के लिए कंट्रोलर इस्तेमाल करें।
english: Press “Enter VR” to step inside. Use the controllers to move and to pick cards.
back: Press "Go into VR" to go inside. Use the controller to move and select cards.

text: WebXR में खुलता है। किसी कार्ड को देखें और उसे चुनने के लिए चुटकी भरें।
english: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select it.
back: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and swipe to select it.

text: हम सर्वर तक नहीं पहुँच सके। अपना कनेक्शन जाँचकर फिर कोशिश करें।
english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
back: We could not reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.

text: आपको यह करने की अनुमति नहीं है।
english: You are not allowed to do that.
back: You're not allowed to do this.

text: यह अभी-अभी बदल गया है। पेज रीफ़्रेश करके फिर कोशिश करें।
english: That has just changed. Refresh and try again.
back: It has just changed. Please refresh the page and try again.

text: यह नहीं हो सका। अपनी लिखी जानकारी जाँचकर फिर कोशिश करें।
english: That did not go through. Check what you entered and try again.
back: It could not be done. Please check your input and try again.

text: बहुत ज़्यादा अनुरोध हो गए। एक मिनट रुककर फिर कोशिश करें।
english: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
back: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.

text: हमारी ओर से कुछ गड़बड़ हो गई। कृपया फिर कोशिश करें।
english: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
back: Something went wrong on our part. Please try again.

text: सेवा अभी उपलब्ध नहीं है। कृपया थोड़ी देर में फिर कोशिश करें।
english: The service is not available right now. Please try again shortly.
back: The service is not available at the moment. Please try again later.

text: कुछ गड़बड़ हो गई। कृपया फिर कोशिश करें।
english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
back: Something went wrong. Please try again.

text: वह पासकी इस खाते में नहीं है।
english: That passkey was not found on this account.

text: कक्षा का नाम 1 से 128 अक्षरों का होना चाहिए।
english: A classroom name must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The class name must be 1 to 128 characters.

text: वह कक्षा कोड मान्य नहीं है। कोड में 6 अक्षर होते हैं।
english: That is not a valid join code. It has 6 letters.
back: That class code is not valid. The code has 6 characters.

text: इस कोड की कोई कक्षा नहीं है। अपने शिक्षक से कोड जाँच लें।

back: In the GLB view on your phone, tap "AR View" to see the cards in your room.

back: 3D tours of your collection available on Quest 3 and Vision Pro via WebXR, and using the mouse on a computer.

back: Load a 3D gallery, drag to look around, scroll to zoom in.

back: Press "Enter VR" to enter. Use the controller to move and select cards.

back: Open with WebXR, look at the card and swipe to select.

back: We can't connect to the server. Please check your connection and try again.

back: You're not allowed to do this.

back: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.

back: The service is currently unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

back: No such paskey found in this account.

back: The access code is incorrect. It's 6 characters long.

back: Shakespearean-style rap battle card game from Inspired Mile. Put your cards, keep your identity and write better than the opponents running on all of your devices.

เวทีโรงละคร
ติดตั้ง Sonnet Man

english: It opens full screen, and an installed app is far less likely to have a downloaded model cleared by the browser.
back: The app opens full-screen, and in installed apps, the browser has much less chance of deleting downloaded models.

back: Keep data on this device 1.1 GB browser will not delete itself

back: The data you download is stored on this device. The browser will not delete it itself.

back: Saves 1.1 GB of data, but the browser may delete it if there is not enough space on your device or you haven't logged in for a while.

english: Your download is stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: The data you downloaded has been saved, but the browser may delete it if there is not enough space on your device or you haven't logged in for a while.

text: ข้าพเจ้าได้อ่านและยอมรับข้อกำหนดการให้บริการและนโยบายความเป็นส่วนตัว แล้ว รวมถึงส่วนที่ว่าด้วยการใช้งานในชั้นเรียนและเพื่อการศึกษา และส่วนที่ว่าด้วยกฎหมาย FERPA

back: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, including the Classroom and Educational Use section and the FERPA section.

back: Do you want to play the stage theatre, showing all the competition in your glasses?

back: Teachers set up classes, assign their students Shakespeare contests and challenges, and track their progress.

back: Create or join a class. Teachers assign Shakespeare contests and challenges to their students and track their progress.

english: Classroom Mode is made for schools. Choose your role to continue.
back: Class mode is reserved for schools, choose your role to follow.

english: Join a classroom that already exists

english: I am a teacher, an instructor or a school administrator, and I am authorised to use this with my students.
back: I am a teacher, trainer or member of a school board and allowed to use this service with my students.

english: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under 18.
back: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under 18.

english: Before you join a classroom, please confirm the following:
back: Before joining a class, please confirm the following:

text: أحد والديّ أو وليّ أمري القانوني يعلم أنني أستخدم Inspired Mile للواجبات المدرسية وقد أذن لي بذلك.
english: My parent or legal guardian knows I am using Inspired Mile for schoolwork and has given permission.
back: A parent or legal guardian knows that I am using Inspired Mile for homework and has authorized me to do so.

text: أعطاني معلّمي رمز الانضمام إلى صف.
english: My teacher has given me a join code for a classroom.
back: My teacher gave me a class enrollment code.

text: أفهم أن معلّمي يستطيع أن يرى تقدّمي وما أفعله في الصف.
english: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and what I do in the classroom.
back: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and what I'm doing in class.

text: أدخل رمز الانضمام المكوّن من 6 أحرف.

english: Enter a name for the classroom.

text: لم تنضم إلى أي صف بعد.
english: You have not joined a classroom yet.
back: She has not joined any class yet.

english: Sign in to see your classrooms.
back: Log in to see your ranks.

text: اختر «إنشاء صف» وامنحه اسمًا، مثل «الصف التاسع (ب) – اللغة الإنجليزية» أو «مدخل إلى شكسبير». يحصل كل صف على رمز انضمام خاص به من 6 أحرف.
english: Choose “Create a classroom” and give it a name, such as “Period 3 English” or “Shakespeare 101”. Each classroom gets its own 6-letter join code.
back: Choose "Create Class" and give it a name, such as "Grade 9(b) – English" or "Introduction to Shakespeare". Each class gets its own 6-character joining code.

text: أعطِ طلابك الرمز المكوّن من 6 أحرف. يختارون «أنا طالب أو طالبة»، ويؤكدون الموافقة، ثم يدخلون الرمز. لا حاجة إلى بريد إلكتروني.
english: Give your students the 6-letter code. They choose “I am a student”, confirm the consent and enter the code. No email address is needed.
back: Give your students the 6-character code. They select “I’m a student,” agree, and then enter the code.

english: Post it on your learning platform
back: Post it on your educational platform.

text: أنشئ واجبات لصفّك: مسابقة عن شكسبير لاختبار المعلومات، أو تحديات اقتباسات تُكمَل فيها الكلمات الناقصة، أو مبارزة بالأبيات للكتابة الإبداعية.
english: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare trivia to check knowledge, quotation challenges to fill in the missing words, or a duel of verses for creative writing.
back: Create assignments for your class: a Shakespeare quiz to test your knowledge, quotation challenges where you complete missing words, or an epic duel for creative writing.

text: 5 أسئلة اختيار من متعدد عن شكسبير
إكمال الكلمات الناقصة في اقتباسات مشهورة
english: Fill in the missing words of famous quotations
back: Completing missing words in famous quotes

text: مبارزة بالأبيات من ثلاث جولات، يُحكَم فيها على الجهاز
english: A three-round duel of verses, judged on the device
back: A three-round poetry contest, judged by the apparatus.

text: اطّلع على ما أنجزه كل طالب، وعلى نتائجه والبطاقات التي كسبها. تبقى البيانات داخل الصف: يرى الطالب تقدّمه هو، وترى أنت تقدّم الجميع.
english: See what each student has completed, their scores and the cards they have earned. The data stays inside the classroom: students see their own progress, and you see everyone's.
back: See what each student has accomplished, their scores and the cards they have earned. The data stays in the classroom: the student sees his progress, you see everyone's progress.

english: Who can see a student's progress
back: Who can see the student's progress?

text: اشترِ بطاقات شكسبير للاقتناء وتبادلها مع لاعبين آخرين.
english: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.
back: Buy Shakespeare cards to acquire and trade with other players.

text: اشترِ البطاقات وتبادلها مع لاعبين آخرين. اعرض بطاقاتك المكرّرة للبيع، أو اعثر على البطاقات التي تنقصك.
english: Buy and trade cards with other players. Offer your duplicates for sale, or find the cards you are missing.
back: Buy cards and trade them with other players. List your duplicate cards for sale, or find the ones you're missing.

english: Bought. The card is now yours.
Sign in to see your listings.
back: Log in to see your offers.

text: البطاقات المطلوبة (أرقام البطاقات، تفصل بينها فواصل)
english: Cards wanted (card numbers, separated by commas)
back: Cards required (card numbers, separated by spaces)

text: أدخل سعرًا لا يقل عن نقطة واحدة.
english: Enter a price of at least 1 credit.
back: Enter a price of at least one point.

english: Sign in to create a listing.
back: Log in to create a presentation.

text: شارك في بطولات مبارزات الأبيات وتنافس على اللقب.
english: Enter tournaments of verse duels and play for the title.
back: Participate in the championships of poetry contests and compete for the title.

text: شارك في مسابقات منظَّمة وأظهر تمكّنك من الشعر. خروج المغلوب، ونظام الدوري، وغير ذلك.
english: Enter organised competitions and show your command of verse. Single elimination, round robin and more.
back: Participate in organized competitions and show your ability to poetry, the loser comes out, league system, etc.

english: Choose a tournament to see its bracket.
back: Select a tournament to see its schedule.

text: لا توجد بطولات بعد. عُد قريبًا.
english: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.

back: Sign in to register for the tournament.

text: لم تُجرَ قرعة جدول البطولة بعد.
english: The bracket has not been drawn yet.
back: The tournament schedule has not yet been drawn.

text: ارفع مستوى بطاقة الموسم لتفتح مكافآت في Inspired Mile.
english: Raise the level of your Season Pass to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.
back: Level up the Season Card to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.

text: العب النزالات والمسابقات والتحديات لتكسب XP. كل مستوى جديد يفتح بطاقات ونقاطًا وألقابًا.
english: Play battles, trivia and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.
back: Play races, competitions and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, points and titles.

text: لا توجد مكافآت لهذا الموسم بعد.
english: This season has no rewards yet.
back: There are no rewards for this season yet.

text: سجّل الدخول ليبقى تقدّمك في بطاقة الموسم محفوظًا على كل أجهزتك.
english: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on every device.
back: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on all your devices.

text: شاهد النماذج ثلاثية الأبعاد للبطاقات، بتقنية Gaussian Splat أو بشبكات GLB.
english: Look at the cards' 3D models, as Gaussian splats or as GLB meshes.
back: View 3D models of cards, with Gaussian Splat or GLB networks.

text: استكشف بطاقاتك في صورة نماذج ثلاثية الأبعاد. بدّل بين عرض Splat وشبكة GLB. اسحب لتدير النموذج، ومرّر للتكبير.
english: Explore your cards as 3D models. Switch between the Gaussian splat and the GLB mesh. Drag to turn the model, scroll to zoom.
back: Explore your cards in a 3D model view. Switch between Splat and GLB grid views. Drag to manipulate the model, slide to zoom.

text: العارض ثلاثي الأبعاد جاهز. اختر بطاقة.
english: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.
back: The 3D viewer is ready. Select a card.

text: تم تحميل hamlet.ply. اسحب لتديره، ومرّر للتكبير.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: Hamlet.ply has been loaded. Drag to manage, drag to zoom.

text: تم تحميل hamlet.ply بجودة مخفّضة. اسحب لتديره، ومرّر للتكبير.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply at reduced quality. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: hamlet.ply has been downloaded in reduced quality. Drag to manage, drag to zoom.

text: خُفّضت جودة الصورة لتبقى الحركة سلسة.
english: Picture quality was lowered to keep the movement smooth.
back: The image quality has been reduced to keep the movement smooth.

text: لا يوجد نموذج GLB للبطاقة Hamlet.
english: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
back: There is no GLB model for the Hamlet card.

text: الملف لا يحتوي على أي نموذج.
back: The file does not contain any template.

english: The model could not be loaded.
The GLB view could not be loaded.

text: نقاط Gaussian Splat يرسمها Babylon.js. أدِر وكبّر وحرّك صورة ثلاثية الأبعاد واقعية للنموذج.
english: Gaussian splats drawn by Babylon.js. Turn, zoom and move around a lifelike 3D picture of the model.
back: Gaussian Splat points drawn by Babylon.js. Edit, zoom and move a realistic 3D image of the model.

text: شبكة عادية تُعرض بواسطة model-viewer. على الهاتف يمكنها وضع النموذج في غرفتك بالواقع المعزَّز.
english: An ordinary mesh shown with model-viewer. On a phone it can place the model in your room in augmented reality.
back: A normal network displayed by a model-viewer on the phone can place the model in your room with augmented reality.

text: في عرض GLB على الهاتف، اضغط «عرض بالواقع المعزَّز» لترى البطاقة في غرفتك.
english: In the GLB view on a phone, tap “View in AR” to see the card in your room.
back: In the GLB display on your phone, press "Augmented Reality Display" to see the card in your room.

text: تجوّل في مجموعة بطاقات شكسبير الخاصة بك في الواقع الافتراضي.
english: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.
back: Roam your own collection of Shakespeare cards in virtual reality.

text: تجوّل في مجموعتك بالأبعاد الثلاثة. يعمل على Quest 3 و Vision Pro عبر WebXR، وبالفأرة على الحاسوب.
english: Walk through your collection in 3D. It works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro through WebXR, and with a mouse on a computer.
back: It runs on Quest 3 and Vision Pro via WebXR, and with the mouse on your computer.

text: تم تحميل المعرض ثلاثي الأبعاد. اسحب لتنظر حولك، ومرّر للتكبير.
english: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: 3D exhibition loaded. Drag to look around, drag to zoom in.

text: لم يُعثر على نظّارة واقع افتراضي. يُعرض المعرض بالأبعاد الثلاثة.
english: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.
back: Virtual reality headset not found. Exhibition is displayed in 3D.
WebXR is ready. Press "Enter Virtual Reality".

text: استخدم زر الواقع الافتراضي في زاوية الصورة.
english: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
back: Use the virtual reality button in the corner of the picture.

text: WebXR غير متاح على هذا الجهاز. يُعرض المعرض بالأبعاد الثلاثة: اسحب لتنظر حولك، ومرّر للتكبير.
english: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: WebXR is not available on this device. The exhibition is displayed in three dimensions: drag to look around, slider to zoom.

text: انقر واسحب لتنظر حولك. مرّر للتكبير. انقر بطاقة لتحديدها.
english: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click a card to select it.
back: Click and drag to look around. Swipe to zoom. Click a card to select it.

text: اضغط «دخول الواقع الافتراضي» لتدخل. استخدم ذراعَي التحكم للتنقّل واختيار البطاقات.
english: Press “Enter VR” to step inside. Use the controllers to move and to pick cards.
back: Press "Enter Virtual Reality" to intervene. Use the joysticks to move and select cards.

text: يُفتح عبر WebXR. انظر إلى بطاقة واقرص بإصبعيك لتحديدها.
english: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select it.
back: Opens via WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to identify it.

text: تعذّر الوصول إلى الخادم. تحقق من اتصالك وحاول مجددًا.
english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
back: Unable to access the server. Please check your connection and try again.

english: You are not allowed to do that.

text: لقد تغيّر ذلك للتوّ. حدّث الصفحة وحاول مجددًا.
english: That has just changed. Refresh and try again.
back: It just changed. Refresh the page and try again.

text: لم ينجح ذلك. راجع ما أدخلته وحاول مجددًا.
english: That did not go through. Check what you entered and try again.
back: It didn't work. Please check your input and try again.

text: طلبات كثيرة جدًّا. انتظر دقيقة ثم حاول مجددًا.
english: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
back: Too many requests, wait a minute and try again.

text: حدث خطأ من جهتنا. حاول مرة أخرى.
english: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
back: There was a mistake on our part.

text: الخدمة غير متاحة الآن. حاول مجددًا بعد قليل.
english: The service is not available right now. Please try again shortly.
back: The service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

text: حدث خطأ ما. حاول مرة أخرى.
english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
back: Something went wrong, please try again.

text: مفتاح المرور هذا غير موجود في هذا الحساب.
english: That passkey was not found on this account.
back: This passkey does not exist in this account.

text: يجب أن يتكوّن اسم الصف من 1 إلى 128 حرفًا.
english: A classroom name must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The class name must consist of 1 to 128 characters.

text: رمز الانضمام هذا غير صالح. الرمز من 6 أحرف.
english: That is not a valid join code. It has 6 letters.
back: This membership code is invalid. The 6-character code.

text: لا يوجد صف بهذا الرمز. تحقق منه مع معلّمك.
english: No classroom has that code. Check it with your teacher.
back: There's no class with this code, check with your teacher.

english: You are not a member of this classroom.
back: I'm not a member of this class.

english: Only the teacher can create assignments.
back: Only the teacher can create homework.

text: يجب أن يتكوّن عنوان الواجب من 1 إلى 128 حرفًا.
english: An assignment title must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The title of the assignment must consist of 1 to 128 characters.

english: That is not a valid card.

text: يجب أن يكون السعر بين 1 و100,000 نقطة.
english: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.
back: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 points.

english: You do not own this card.
That listing is no longer open.
back: This show is no longer open.

english: You cannot buy your own listing.
Registration for this tournament is closed.
back: Registration for this tournament is closed.

english: That match has already been decided.
back: This match has already been decided.

english: No season is running right now.
back: There's no season running right now.

english: You have not reached that level yet.
back: This level has not yet been reached.

english: That reward has already been claimed.
back: This reward has already been received.

english: You do not have enough credits.

text: بلغت حدّ الإنفاق اليومي للاعبين دون 18 عامًا.
english: You have reached today's spending limit for players under 18.
back: The daily spending limit for players under 18 has been reached.

text: لقد فتحت هذه النسخة من قبل.
english: You have already unlocked that variant.
That is not a valid invitation code.

back: There is no invitation under this code.

text: لا يمكنك استخدام رمز دعوتك أنت.
english: You cannot use your own invitation code.
back: You can't use your invitation code.

text: تعذّر عرض هذا الجزء من الصفحة.
english: This part of the page could not be shown.
back: This part of the page cannot be displayed.

text: بعض أجزاء اللعبة تحتاج إلى اتصال بالإنترنت. تحقق من اتصالك وحاول مجددًا.
english: Some parts of the game need an internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
back: Some parts of the game require an Internet connection. Check your connection and try again.

english: Sonnet Man: the duel of verses

text: لعبة بطاقات شكسبيرية على طريقة الباتل راب، من Inspired Mile. العب بطاقاتك، والتزم بالقالب، واكتب أفضل من خصم يعمل بالكامل على جهازك.
english: A Shakespeare rap-battle card game from Inspired Mile. Play your cards, keep the form, and out-write an opponent that runs entirely on your device.
back: A Shakespearean card game in battle rap style, by Inspired Mile. Play your cards, stick to the template, and write better than an opponent who runs fully on your device.

text: يُفتح بملء الشاشة، ويقلّ كثيرًا احتمال أن يحذف المتصفح نموذجًا منزَّلًا في تطبيق مثبَّت.
english: It opens full screen, and an installed app is far less likely to have a downloaded model cleared by the browser.
back: It opens in full screen, and it is much less likely that the browser will delete a home template in an installed application.

text: على iPhone وiPad لا يشارك تطبيق الشاشة الرئيسية هذا التبويب أي شيء. أضِفه قبل تسجيل الدخول أو تنزيل نموذج، وإلا فستفعل الأمرين مرتين.
english: On iPhone and iPad the Home Screen app shares nothing with this tab. Add it before you sign in or download a model, or you will do both twice.
back: On iPhone and iPad the Home screen app does not share this tab with anything. Add it before logging in or downloading a template, otherwise you'll do both things twice.

text: محفوظ على هذا الجهاز: 1.1 غ.ب. لن يحذفه متصفحك من تلقاء نفسه.
english: 1.1 GB kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: Saved on this device: 1.1 GB Your browser won't delete it by itself.

text: ما نزّلته محفوظ على هذا الجهاز. لن يحذفه متصفحك من تلقاء نفسه.
english: Your download is kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: What you downloaded is stored on this device. Your browser won't delete it by itself.

text: مخزَّن على هذا الجهاز: 1.1 غ.ب، لكن قد يحذفه متصفحك إذا ضاقت مساحة الجهاز أو غبتَ مدة.
english: 1.1 GB stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: Stored on this device: 1.1 GB, but may be deleted by your browser if the device runs out of space or for some time.

text: ما نزّلته مخزَّن، لكن قد يحذفه متصفحك إذا ضاقت مساحة الجهاز أو غبتَ مدة.
english: Your download is stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: What you download is stored, but may be deleted by your browser if the device runs out of space or for some time.

text: تثبيت التطبيق يساعد على الاحتفاظ به.
english: Installing the app helps keep it.
back: Installing the application helps to maintain it.

text: قرأت شروط الخدمة وسياسة الخصوصية وأوافق عليهما، بما في ذلك الأقسام الخاصة بالاستخدام في الصف وللأغراض التعليمية وبقانون FERPA.
english: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy, including the sections on classroom and educational use and on FERPA.
back: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, including the sections on Classroom Use, Educational Purposes and FERPA.

text: أتريد اللعب؟ المسرح يعرض المبارزة كاملة داخل نظّارتك.
english: Want to play? The Theatre stages the whole duel in your headset.
back: The theatre shows the whole wrestling inside your glasses.

text: Giáo viên tạo lớp học, giao đố vui và thử thách về Shakespeare, rồi theo dõi tiến độ của học sinh.
english: Teachers create classrooms, set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Teachers set up classes, gave fun puzzles and challenges about Shakespeare, and then monitored the progress of students.

text: Tạo một lớp học hoặc tham gia một lớp. Giáo viên giao đố vui và thử thách về Shakespeare, rồi theo dõi tiến độ của học sinh.
english: Create or join a classroom. Teachers set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Create a class or join a class. Teachers give fun puzzles and challenges about Shakespeare, then track the progress of students.

text: Chế độ Lớp học được làm cho nhà trường. Hãy chọn vai trò của bạn để tiếp tục.
english: Classroom Mode is made for schools. Choose your role to continue.
back: Classroom mode is created for the school. Please select your role to continue.

text: Tạo và quản lý lớp học
Tham gia một lớp học đã có
english: Join a classroom that already exists

text: Tôi là giáo viên, giảng viên hoặc cán bộ quản lý nhà trường, và tôi được phép dùng dịch vụ này với học sinh của mình.
english: I am a teacher, an instructor or a school administrator, and I am authorised to use this with my students.
back: I am a teacher, lecturer or school administrator, and I have permission to use this service with my students.

text: Tôi sẽ xin sự đồng ý của cha mẹ hoặc người giám hộ trước khi ghi danh bất kỳ học sinh nào dưới 18 tuổi.
english: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under 18.
back: I will seek the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under the age of 18.

text: Tiếp tục với vai trò giáo viên
back: Continue with the role of a teacher .

text: Sự đồng ý của học sinh
Trước khi tham gia một lớp học, hãy xác nhận những điều sau:
english: Before you join a classroom, please confirm the following:
back: Before joining a class, please confirm the following:

text: Cha mẹ hoặc người giám hộ hợp pháp của tôi biết tôi dùng Inspired Mile cho việc học ở trường và đã cho phép.
english: My parent or legal guardian knows I am using Inspired Mile for schoolwork and has given permission.
back: My parent or legal guardian knows that I am using Inspired Mile for school and has given permission.

text: Giáo viên đã cho tôi mã tham gia lớp học.
english: My teacher has given me a join code for a classroom.
back: The teacher gave me a code to join the class.

text: Tôi hiểu rằng giáo viên có thể xem tiến độ và hoạt động của tôi trong lớp học.
english: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and what I do in the classroom.
back: I understand that the teacher can see my progress and activities in class.

text: Tiếp tục với vai trò học sinh
back: Let 's continue with the student role .

text: Hãy nhập mã tham gia gồm 6 chữ cái.
Hãy nhập tên cho lớp học.
english: Enter a name for the classroom.
back: Please enter a name for the class.

text: Bạn chưa tham gia lớp học nào.
english: You have not joined a classroom yet.

text: Đăng nhập để xem các lớp học của bạn.
english: Sign in to see your classrooms.
back: Log in to view your classes.

text: Quay lại các lớp học của tôi
Chọn “Tạo lớp học” và đặt tên cho lớp, chẳng hạn “Lớp 9A – Ngữ văn” hoặc “Làm quen với Shakespeare”. Mỗi lớp học có một mã tham gia riêng gồm 6 chữ cái.
english: Choose “Create a classroom” and give it a name, such as “Period 3 English” or “Shakespeare 101”. Each classroom gets its own 6-letter join code.
back: Choose "Create Class" and give the class a name, for example "Grade 9A – Literature" or "Getting to Know Shakespeare". Each class has its own six-letter enrollment code.

text: Ví dụ về mã tham gia
Đưa cho học sinh mã gồm 6 chữ cái. Các em chọn “Tôi là học sinh”, xác nhận sự đồng ý rồi nhập mã. Không cần địa chỉ email.
english: Give your students the 6-letter code. They choose “I am a student”, confirm the consent and enter the code. No email address is needed.
back: Give students a 6-character code. They select "I am a student", confirm the agreement and enter the code. No email address is required.

text: Đăng lên nền tảng học tập của bạn
english: Post it on your learning platform

text: In phiếu phát cho học sinh
Tạo bài tập cho lớp của bạn: đố vui về Shakespeare để kiểm tra kiến thức, thử thách điền từ còn thiếu vào câu trích dẫn, hoặc một trận đấu thơ để luyện viết sáng tạo.
english: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare trivia to check knowledge, quotation challenges to fill in the missing words, or a duel of verses for creative writing.
back: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare quizzes to test knowledge, challenges to fill in missing words into quotes, or a poetry match to practice creative writing.

text: 5 câu hỏi trắc nghiệm về Shakespeare
Điền từ còn thiếu vào những câu trích dẫn nổi tiếng
english: Fill in the missing words of famous quotations
back: Fill in the missing words in famous quotes .

text: Một trận đấu thơ ba hiệp, được chấm ngay trên thiết bị
english: A three-round duel of verses, judged on the device
back: A three-round poetry match, scored right on the device.

text: Xem mỗi học sinh đã hoàn thành những gì, điểm số và các lá bài các em giành được. Dữ liệu chỉ nằm trong lớp học: học sinh thấy tiến độ của riêng mình, còn bạn thấy tiến độ của cả lớp.
english: See what each student has completed, their scores and the cards they have earned. The data stays inside the classroom: students see their own progress, and you see everyone's.
back: See what each student has completed, their scores and the cards they have won. The data is only for the class: students see their own progress, while you see the progress of the whole class.

text: Ai xem được tiến độ của học sinh
english: Who can see a student's progress
back: Who can see the student's progress?

text: Mua và trao đổi thẻ bài sưu tầm Shakespeare với những người chơi khác.
english: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.
back: Buy and trade Shakespeare collection cards with other players.

text: Mua và trao đổi lá bài với những người chơi khác. Rao bán những lá bài trùng của bạn, hoặc tìm những lá bài bạn còn thiếu.
english: Buy and trade cards with other players. Offer your duplicates for sale, or find the cards you are missing.
back: Buy and trade cards with other players. Sell your spares, or find the cards you're missing.

text: Không tìm thấy tin đăng nào.
Muốn đổi lấy: MO-001 và CA-001
back: I want to exchange: MO-001 and CA-001.

text: Đăng nhập để mua lá bài.
Đã mua. Lá bài giờ là của bạn.
english: Bought. The card is now yours.

text: Đăng nhập để xem tin đăng của bạn.
english: Sign in to see your listings.
back: Log in to view your posts.

text: Bạn chưa có tin đăng nào.
Chọn một lá bài để đăng…
Lá bài muốn đổi lấy (số của lá bài, cách nhau bằng dấu phẩy)
english: Cards wanted (card numbers, separated by commas)
back: Cards to swap (number of cards, separated by commas)

text: Hãy nhập giá ít nhất 1 xu.
english: Enter a price of at least 1 credit.
back: Put in at least a penny.

text: Đăng nhập để tạo tin đăng.
english: Sign in to create a listing.
back: Log in to create a post.

text: Tham gia các giải đấu thơ và tranh danh hiệu.
english: Enter tournaments of verse duels and play for the title.
back: Participate in poetry competitions and title fights.

text: Tham gia các cuộc thi có tổ chức và cho thấy tài làm thơ của bạn. Loại trực tiếp, vòng tròn và nhiều thể thức khác.
english: Enter organised competitions and show your command of verse. Single elimination, round robin and more.
back: Take part in organized competitions and show off your poetry skills. Direct type, circle and many other formats.

text: Chọn một giải đấu để xem sơ đồ thi đấu.
english: Choose a tournament to see its bracket.
back: Select a tournament to see the match chart.

text: Chưa có giải đấu nào. Hãy quay lại sau nhé.
english: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.
back: There's no tournament yet, come back later.

text: Bạn đã đăng ký thành công.
Đang tải sơ đồ thi đấu…
Sơ đồ thi đấu chưa được bốc thăm.
english: The bracket has not been drawn yet.

text: Nâng cấp độ Thẻ mùa giải để mở khóa phần thưởng trong Inspired Mile.
english: Raise the level of your Season Pass to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.
back: Upgrade the Season Card to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.

text: Chơi các trận đấu, đố vui và thử thách để nhận XP. Mỗi cấp độ mới mở khóa lá bài, xu và danh hiệu.
english: Play battles, trivia and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.
back: Play matches, puzzles and challenges to earn XP. Each level unlocks new cards, coins and titles.

text: Còn 150 XP nữa là lên cấp
Đã đạt cấp độ cao nhất
back: The highest level has been reached

text: Mùa giải này chưa có phần thưởng.
english: This season has no rewards yet.
back: There are no prizes this season.

text: Đăng nhập để giữ tiến độ Thẻ mùa giải của bạn trên mọi thiết bị.
english: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on every device.
back: Sign in to keep track of your Season Pass progress on all devices.

text: Xem mô hình 3D của các lá bài, ở dạng Gaussian splat hoặc lưới GLB.
english: Look at the cards' 3D models, as Gaussian splats or as GLB meshes.
back: View a 3D model of the cards, in the form of Gaussian splat or GLB grid.

text: Khám phá các lá bài của bạn dưới dạng mô hình 3D. Chuyển giữa Gaussian splat và lưới GLB. Kéo để xoay mô hình, cuộn để phóng to hoặc thu nhỏ.
english: Explore your cards as 3D models. Switch between the Gaussian splat and the GLB mesh. Drag to turn the model, scroll to zoom.
back: Explore your cards as a 3D model. Switch between Gaussian splat and GLB grid. Drag to rotate the model, scroll to zoom in or out.

text: Trình xem 3D đã sẵn sàng. Hãy chọn một lá bài.
english: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.
back: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.

text: Đã tải hamlet.ply. Kéo để xoay, cuộn để phóng to hoặc thu nhỏ.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: Hamlet.ply loaded. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom in or out.

text: Đã tải hamlet.ply với chất lượng thấp hơn. Kéo để xoay, cuộn để phóng to hoặc thu nhỏ.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply at reduced quality. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: Loaded hamlet.ply with lower quality. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom in or out.

text: Chất lượng hình ảnh đã được giảm để chuyển động được mượt.
english: Picture quality was lowered to keep the movement smooth.
back: The image quality has been reduced to make the motion smooth.

text: Đã tải mô hình GLB: Hamlet
Không có mô hình GLB cho Hamlet.
english: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
back: There's no GLB model for Hamlet.

text: Tệp không chứa mô hình nào.
back: The file does not contain any models.

english: The model could not be loaded.

text: Không khởi động được trình xem 3D.
Không tải được chế độ GLB.
english: The GLB view could not be loaded.

text: Gaussian splat do Babylon.js vẽ. Xoay, phóng to và di chuyển một hình ảnh 3D chân thực của mô hình.
english: Gaussian splats drawn by Babylon.js. Turn, zoom and move around a lifelike 3D picture of the model.
back: Gaussian splat drawn by Babylon.js. Rotate, zoom and move a realistic 3D image of the model.

text: Một lưới thông thường hiển thị bằng model-viewer. Trên điện thoại, nó có thể đặt mô hình vào phòng bạn bằng thực tế tăng cường.
english: An ordinary mesh shown with model-viewer. On a phone it can place the model in your room in augmented reality.
back: A typical grid displayed by a model-viewer. On the phone, it can place models in your room using augmented reality.

text: Ở chế độ GLB trên điện thoại, hãy chạm “Xem bằng AR” để thấy lá bài ngay trong phòng bạn.
english: In the GLB view on a phone, tap “View in AR” to see the card in your room.
back: In GLB mode on your phone, tap "View with AR" to see the cards right in your room.

text: Dạo qua bộ sưu tập lá bài Shakespeare của bạn trong thực tế ảo.
english: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.
back: Browse through your collection of Shakespeare cards in virtual reality.

text: Dạo qua bộ sưu tập của bạn trong không gian 3D. Chạy trên Quest 3 và Vision Pro qua WebXR, và dùng chuột trên máy tính.
english: Walk through your collection in 3D. It works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro through WebXR, and with a mouse on a computer.
back: Browse your collection in 3D space. Run on Quest 3 and Vision Pro via WebXR, and use the mouse on a PC.

text: Phòng trưng bày 3D đã tải xong. Kéo để nhìn quanh, cuộn để phóng to hoặc thu nhỏ.
english: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: The 3D gallery has been loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom in or out.

text: Không tìm thấy kính VR. Phòng trưng bày được hiển thị ở dạng 3D.
english: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.
back: No VR headset found. The showroom is displayed in 3D.

text: WebXR đã sẵn sàng. Hãy bấm “Vào VR”.
Hãy dùng nút VR ở góc hình.
english: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
back: Let's use the VR button in the corner.

text: WebXR không dùng được ở đây.
Không khởi động được phòng trưng bày 3D.
WebXR không dùng được trên thiết bị này. Phòng trưng bày được hiển thị ở dạng 3D: kéo để nhìn quanh, cuộn để phóng to hoặc thu nhỏ.
english: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is displayed in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom in or out.

text: Bấm và kéo để nhìn quanh. Cuộn để phóng to hoặc thu nhỏ. Bấm vào một lá bài để chọn.
english: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click a card to select it.
back: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom in or out. Click on a card to select.

text: Bấm “Vào VR” để bước vào trong. Dùng tay cầm để di chuyển và chọn lá bài.
english: Press “Enter VR” to step inside. Use the controllers to move and to pick cards.
back: Click "Enter VR" to enter. Use the joystick to move and select cards.

text: Mở bằng WebXR. Nhìn vào một lá bài rồi chụm ngón tay để chọn.
english: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select it.
back: Open with WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select.

text: Không kết nối được với máy chủ. Hãy kiểm tra mạng rồi thử lại.
english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
back: Unable to connect to the server. Please check your network and try again.

text: Bạn không được phép làm việc đó.
english: You are not allowed to do that.
back: You're not allowed to do that.

text: Chúng tôi không tìm thấy mục đó.
Mục đó vừa thay đổi. Hãy làm mới trang rồi thử lại.
english: That has just changed. Refresh and try again.
back: That entry has been changed. Please refresh the page and try again.

text: Thao tác không thành công. Hãy kiểm tra những gì bạn đã nhập rồi thử lại.
english: That did not go through. Check what you entered and try again.
back: Operation failed. Please check what you entered and try again.

text: Quá nhiều yêu cầu. Hãy chờ một phút rồi thử lại.
english: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
back: Too many requests, please wait a minute and try again.

text: Đã có lỗi ở phía chúng tôi. Vui lòng thử lại.
english: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
back: There was an error on our part, please try again.

text: Dịch vụ hiện không dùng được. Vui lòng thử lại sau ít phút.
english: The service is not available right now. Please try again shortly.
back: The service is currently unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.

text: Đã có lỗi xảy ra. Vui lòng thử lại.
english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
back: An error has occurred. Please try again.

text: Khóa truy cập đó không có trong tài khoản này.
english: That passkey was not found on this account.
back: That access key is not in this account.

text: Tên lớp học phải có từ 1 đến 128 ký tự.
english: A classroom name must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The class name must be between 1 and 128 characters.

text: Mã tham gia đó không hợp lệ. Mã gồm 6 chữ cái.
english: That is not a valid join code. It has 6 letters.
back: This entry code is not valid. The code is 6 characters long.

text: Không có lớp học nào dùng mã đó. Hãy hỏi lại giáo viên của bạn.
english: No classroom has that code. Check it with your teacher.
back: There's no class that uses this code, so ask your teacher.

text: Bạn không phải là thành viên của lớp học này.
english: You are not a member of this classroom.
back: You're not a member of this class.

text: Chỉ giáo viên mới tạo được bài tập.
english: Only the teacher can create assignments.
back: Only the teacher can create assignments.

text: Tiêu đề bài tập phải có từ 1 đến 128 ký tự.
english: An assignment title must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The title of the assignment must be between 1 and 128 characters.

text: Lá bài đó không hợp lệ.
english: That is not a valid card.

text: Giá phải nằm trong khoảng từ 1 đến 100.000 xu.
english: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.
back: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 pence.

text: Bạn không có lá bài này.
english: You do not own this card.

text: Tin đăng đó không còn nữa.

english: That listing is no longer open.

text: Bạn không thể mua tin đăng của chính mình.
english: You cannot buy your own listing.
back: You can't buy your own ads.

text: Giải đấu đó không còn nữa.
Giải đấu này đã đóng đăng ký.
english: Registration for this tournament is closed.
back: This tournament is closed for registration.

text: Giải đấu này đã đủ người.
back: There's enough people in this tournament.

text: Trận đấu đó không còn nữa.
Trận đấu đó đã có kết quả.
english: That match has already been decided.

text: Hiện không có mùa giải nào đang diễn ra.
english: No season is running right now.
back: There is currently no season going on.

text: Bạn chưa đạt cấp độ đó.
english: You have not reached that level yet.

text: Phần thưởng đó đã được nhận rồi.
english: That reward has already been claimed.
back: That reward has already been received.

english: You do not have enough credits.

text: Bạn đã chạm giới hạn chi tiêu hôm nay dành cho người chơi dưới 18 tuổi.
english: You have reached today's spending limit for players under 18.
back: You have reached the spending limit for players under 18 today.

text: Bạn đã mở khóa biến thể đó rồi.
english: You have already unlocked that variant.

text: Mã mời đó không hợp lệ.
english: That is not a valid invitation code.

text: Không có lời mời nào dùng mã đó.
back: There's no invitation to use that code.

text: Bạn không thể dùng mã mời của chính mình.
english: You cannot use your own invitation code.
back: You cannot use your own invite code.

text: Không hiển thị được phần này của trang.
english: This part of the page could not be shown.
back: This part of the page cannot be displayed.

text: Một số phần của trò chơi cần có kết nối internet. Hãy kiểm tra mạng rồi thử lại.
english: Some parts of the game need an internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
back: Some parts of the game require an Internet connection. Please check your network and try again.

text: Vẫn dùng được khi ngoại tuyến

english: Sonnet Man: the duel of verses

text: Trò chơi bài rap chiến theo phong cách Shakespeare của Inspired Mile. Đánh lá bài của bạn, giữ đúng thể thơ và viết hay hơn một đối thủ chạy hoàn toàn trên thiết bị của bạn.
english: A Shakespeare rap-battle card game from Inspired Mile. Play your cards, keep the form, and out-write an opponent that runs entirely on your device.
back: Inspired Mile's Shakespeare-style rap battle card game. Hit your cards, keep the verse and write better than an opponent running entirely on your device.

text: Hãy cài đặt Sonnet Man trước
Ứng dụng mở toàn màn hình, và với ứng dụng đã cài đặt, khả năng trình duyệt xóa mô hình đã tải thấp hơn nhiều.
english: It opens full screen, and an installed app is far less likely to have a downloaded model cleared by the browser.
back: The application opens full-screen, and with the app installed, the browser's ability to delete loaded models is much lower.

text: Trên iPhone và iPad, ứng dụng ở Màn hình chính không dùng chung gì với thẻ này. Hãy thêm nó trước khi đăng nhập hoặc tải mô hình, nếu không bạn sẽ phải làm cả hai việc hai lần.
english: On iPhone and iPad the Home Screen app shares nothing with this tab. Add it before you sign in or download a model, or you will do both twice.
back: On iPhone and iPad, the apps on the Home Screen have nothing in common with this tab. Please add it before logging in or loading a model, otherwise you will have to do both twice.

text: Đã giữ 1,1 GB trên thiết bị này. Trình duyệt sẽ không tự xóa.
english: 1.1 GB kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: You have 1.1 GB left on this device. The browser will not delete itself.

text: Dữ liệu bạn tải được giữ trên thiết bị này. Trình duyệt sẽ không tự xóa.
english: Your download is kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: The data you downloaded is stored on this device. The browser will not erase itself.

text: Đã lưu 1,1 GB, nhưng trình duyệt có thể xóa nếu thiết bị hết dung lượng hoặc bạn không quay lại trong một thời gian.
english: 1.1 GB stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: 1.1 GB has been saved, but the browser can delete it if the device runs out of space or you don't return for a while.

text: Dữ liệu bạn tải đã được lưu, nhưng trình duyệt có thể xóa nếu thiết bị hết dung lượng hoặc bạn không quay lại trong một thời gian.
english: Your download is stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: The data you download has been saved, but the browser may delete it if your device runs out of storage or you have not returned for a while.

text: Cài đặt ứng dụng giúp giữ lại dữ liệu.
english: Installing the app helps keep it.
back: Install an application to keep the data.

text: Tôi đã đọc và đồng ý với Điều khoản dịch vụ và Chính sách quyền riêng tư, kể cả các phần về việc sử dụng trong lớp học và cho mục đích giáo dục và về đạo luật FERPA.
english: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy, including the sections on classroom and educational use and on FERPA.
back: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, including the sections on use in the classroom and for educational purposes and on FERPA.

text: Bạn muốn chơi? Nhà hát dựng trọn trận đấu thơ ngay trong kính của bạn.
english: Want to play? The Theatre stages the whole duel in your headset.
back: If you want to play, the theatre will set up a poetry match right in your glasses.

text: Guru membuat kelas, memberikan kuis dan tantangan tentang Shakespeare, serta memantau kemajuan siswa.
english: Teachers create classrooms, set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Teachers create classes, give quizzes and challenges about Shakespeare, and monitor student progress.

text: Buat kelas atau bergabung ke sebuah kelas. Guru memberikan kuis dan tantangan tentang Shakespeare, serta memantau kemajuan siswa.
english: Create or join a classroom. Teachers set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Create or join a class. Teachers give quizzes and challenges about Shakespeare, and monitor students' progress.

text: Mode Kelas dibuat untuk sekolah. Pilih peranmu untuk melanjutkan.
english: Classroom Mode is made for schools. Choose your role to continue.
back: Classroom mode is made for school. Choose your role to continue.

text: Bergabung ke kelas yang sudah ada
english: Join a classroom that already exists

text: Saya guru, instruktur, atau pengelola sekolah, dan saya berwenang memakai layanan ini bersama siswa saya.
english: I am a teacher, an instructor or a school administrator, and I am authorised to use this with my students.
back: I am a teacher, instructor, or school administrator, and I am authorized to use this service with my students.

text: Saya akan meminta persetujuan orang tua atau wali sebelum mendaftarkan siswa yang berusia di bawah 18 tahun.
english: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under 18.
back: I will ask for the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling students under 18 years old.

text: Sebelum bergabung ke kelas, mohon pastikan hal-hal berikut:
english: Before you join a classroom, please confirm the following:
back: Before joining the class, please make sure of the following:

text: Orang tua atau wali sah saya tahu bahwa saya memakai Inspired Mile untuk tugas sekolah dan sudah mengizinkannya.
english: My parent or legal guardian knows I am using Inspired Mile for schoolwork and has given permission.
back: My parent or legal guardian knows that I'm using Inspired Mile for school assignments and has permitted it.

text: Guru saya sudah memberi saya kode gabung untuk sebuah kelas.
english: My teacher has given me a join code for a classroom.
back: My teacher has given me a joining code for a class.

text: Saya mengerti bahwa guru saya dapat melihat kemajuan dan kegiatan saya di kelas.
english: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and what I do in the classroom.
back: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and activities in class.

english: Enter a name for the classroom.

text: Kamu belum bergabung ke kelas mana pun.
english: You have not joined a classroom yet.
Sign in to see your classrooms.
back: Come in to see your class.

text: Pilih “Buat kelas” dan beri nama, misalnya “Kelas 9B – Bahasa Inggris” atau “Mengenal Shakespeare”. Setiap kelas mendapat kode gabung 6 huruf sendiri.
english: Choose “Create a classroom” and give it a name, such as “Period 3 English” or “Shakespeare 101”. Each classroom gets its own 6-letter join code.
back: Choose "Create Class" and give it a name, for example "Class 9B – English" or "Know Shakespeare". Each class gets its own six-letter code.

text: Berikan kode 6 huruf itu kepada siswa. Mereka memilih “Saya siswa”, mengonfirmasi persetujuan, lalu memasukkan kodenya. Alamat email tidak diperlukan.
english: Give your students the 6-letter code. They choose “I am a student”, confirm the consent and enter the code. No email address is needed.
back: Give the 6-character code to students. They select “I’m a student,” confirm their agreement, and then enter the code.

english: Post it on your learning platform

text: Buat tugas untuk kelasmu: kuis Shakespeare untuk menguji pengetahuan, tantangan kutipan dengan melengkapi kata yang hilang, atau duel syair untuk menulis kreatif.
english: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare trivia to check knowledge, quotation challenges to fill in the missing words, or a duel of verses for creative writing.
back: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare quizzes to test knowledge, quotation challenges by completing missing words, or poetry duels for creative writing.
Five multiple choice questions about Shakespeare

text: Melengkapi kata yang hilang dalam kutipan terkenal
english: Fill in the missing words of famous quotations
back: Completing missing words in famous quotes

text: Duel syair tiga ronde, dinilai di perangkat
english: A three-round duel of verses, judged on the device
back: Three-round chess duel, scored on device

text: Lihat apa yang sudah diselesaikan setiap siswa, nilainya, dan kartu yang diperolehnya. Data tetap berada di dalam kelas: siswa melihat kemajuannya sendiri, dan kamu melihat kemajuan semua siswa.
english: See what each student has completed, their scores and the cards they have earned. The data stays inside the classroom: students see their own progress, and you see everyone's.
back: See what each student has completed, their grades, and the cards they have received. The data remains in the classroom: students see their own progress, and you see the progress of all students.

text: Siapa yang dapat melihat kemajuan siswa
english: Who can see a student's progress
back: Who can see the student's progress

text: Beli dan tukar kartu koleksi Shakespeare dengan pemain lain.
english: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.
back: Buy and trade Shakespeare collection cards with other players.

text: Beli dan tukar kartu dengan pemain lain. Tawarkan kartu gandamu untuk dijual, atau temukan kartu yang belum kamu punya.
english: Buy and trade cards with other players. Offer your duplicates for sale, or find the cards you are missing.
back: Buy and trade cards with other players, offer your doubles for sale, or find cards you don't have.

english: Bought. The card is now yours.
Sign in to see your listings.
back: Come in to see your offer.

text: Kartu yang dicari (nomor kartu, dipisahkan koma)
english: Cards wanted (card numbers, separated by commas)
back: Cards to look for (card numbers, comma separated)

english: Enter a price of at least 1 credit.
back: Enter a minimum price of 1 credit.

english: Sign in to create a listing.
back: Come in to make an offer.

text: Ikuti turnamen duel syair dan rebut gelarnya.
english: Enter tournaments of verse duels and play for the title.
back: Take part in a poetry duel tournament and claim the title.

text: Ikuti kompetisi terorganisasi dan tunjukkan kemahiranmu bersyair. Sistem gugur, sistem kompetisi, dan lainnya.
english: Enter organised competitions and show your command of verse. Single elimination, round robin and more.
back: Take part in organized competitions and show off your poetry skills.

text: Pilih turnamen untuk melihat bagan pertandingannya.
english: Choose a tournament to see its bracket.
back: Select a tournament to see its match chart.

text: Belum ada turnamen. Kembali lagi nanti.
english: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.
back: There's no tournament, come back later.

english: The bracket has not been drawn yet.
back: The match table has not been drawn.

text: Naikkan level Tiket Musim-mu untuk membuka hadiah di Inspired Mile.
english: Raise the level of your Season Pass to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.
back: Level up your Season Ticket to unlock rewards at the Inspired Mile.

text: Mainkan pertarungan, kuis, dan tantangan untuk mendapat XP. Setiap level baru membuka kartu, kredit, dan gelar.
english: Play battles, trivia and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.
back: Play battles, quizzes and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits, and titles.
150 more XP to the next level

english: This season has no rewards yet.

text: Masuk agar kemajuan Tiket Musim-mu tersimpan di semua perangkat.
english: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on every device.
back: Sign in to save your Season Ticket progress on all devices.

text: Lihat model 3D kartu, sebagai Gaussian splat atau sebagai mesh GLB.
english: Look at the cards' 3D models, as Gaussian splats or as GLB meshes.
back: See 3D card model, as Gaussian splat or as GLB mesh.

text: Jelajahi kartumu sebagai model 3D. Beralihlah antara Gaussian splat dan mesh GLB. Seret untuk memutar model, gulir untuk memperbesar.
english: Explore your cards as 3D models. Switch between the Gaussian splat and the GLB mesh. Drag to turn the model, scroll to zoom.
back: Explore your map as a 3D model. Switch between Gaussian splat and GLB mesh. Drag to rotate the model, scroll to zoom in.

text: Penampil 3D sudah siap. Pilih sebuah kartu.
english: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.

text: hamlet.ply sudah dimuat. Seret untuk memutarnya, gulir untuk memperbesar.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: hamlet.ply has been loaded. drag to rotate, scroll to zoom in.

text: hamlet.ply dimuat dengan kualitas lebih rendah. Seret untuk memutarnya, gulir untuk memperbesar.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply at reduced quality. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: hamlet.ply loaded in lower quality. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.

text: Kualitas gambar diturunkan agar gerakan tetap mulus.
english: Picture quality was lowered to keep the movement smooth.
back: The image quality is lowered to keep the movement smooth.

text: Tidak ada model GLB untuk Hamlet.
english: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
back: There's no GLB model for Hamlet.
This file does not contain a model.

english: The model could not be loaded.

back: The 3D viewer could not be started.

english: The GLB view could not be loaded.
back: The GLB display cannot be loaded.

text: Gaussian splat yang digambar dengan Babylon.js. Putar, perbesar, dan geser gambar 3D model yang tampak nyata.
english: Gaussian splats drawn by Babylon.js. Turn, zoom and move around a lifelike 3D picture of the model.
back: Gaussian splat drawn with Babylon.js. Rotate, zoom, and pan the 3D model image to look realistic.

text: Mesh biasa yang ditampilkan dengan model-viewer. Di ponsel, model dapat diletakkan di ruanganmu dengan realitas tertambah.
english: An ordinary mesh shown with model-viewer. On a phone it can place the model in your room in augmented reality.
back: On a phone, the model can be placed in your room with augmented reality.

text: Pada tampilan GLB di ponsel, ketuk “Lihat dalam AR” untuk melihat kartu di ruanganmu.
english: In the GLB view on a phone, tap “View in AR” to see the card in your room.
back: On the GLB display on your phone, tap “See in AR” to see cards in your room.

text: Jelajahi koleksi kartu Shakespeare-mu dalam realitas virtual.
english: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.
back: Explore your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.

text: Jelajahi koleksimu dalam 3D. Berjalan di Quest 3 dan Vision Pro melalui WebXR, dan dengan tetikus di komputer.
english: Walk through your collection in 3D. It works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro through WebXR, and with a mouse on a computer.
back: Explore your collection in 3D, running on Quest 3 and Vision Pro via WebXR, and with the mouse on a computer.

text: Galeri 3D sudah dimuat. Seret untuk melihat sekeliling, gulir untuk memperbesar.
english: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: 3D gallery already loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom in.

text: Headset VR tidak ditemukan. Galeri ditampilkan dalam 3D.
english: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.
back: VR headset not found. Gallery displayed in 3D.

text: Gunakan tombol VR di sudut gambar.
english: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
back: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
The 3D gallery could not be started.

text: WebXR tidak tersedia di perangkat ini. Galeri ditampilkan dalam 3D: seret untuk melihat sekeliling, gulir untuk memperbesar.
english: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: WebXR is not available on this device. Gallery displayed in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom in.

text: Klik dan seret untuk melihat sekeliling. Gulir untuk memperbesar. Klik sebuah kartu untuk memilihnya.
english: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click a card to select it.
back: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom in. Click a card to select it.

text: Tekan “Masuk VR” untuk masuk ke dalamnya. Gunakan pengendali untuk bergerak dan memilih kartu.
english: Press “Enter VR” to step inside. Use the controllers to move and to pick cards.
back: Press “Enter VR” to enter it. Use the controls to move and select cards.

text: Terbuka dalam WebXR. Tatap sebuah kartu, lalu cubit untuk memilihnya.
english: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select it.
back: Open in WebXR. Tap a card, then swipe to select it.

text: Kami tidak bisa menghubungi server. Periksa koneksimu dan coba lagi.
english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
back: We can't reach the server, please check your connection and try again.

english: You are not allowed to do that.
back: You're not allowed to do that.

text: Itu baru saja berubah. Segarkan halaman dan coba lagi.
english: That has just changed. Refresh and try again.
back: It just changed, refresh the page and try again.

text: Itu tidak berhasil. Periksa yang kamu masukkan dan coba lagi.
english: That did not go through. Check what you entered and try again.
back: It didn't work, check what you entered and try again.

text: Terlalu banyak permintaan. Tunggu satu menit, lalu coba lagi.
english: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
back: Too many requests, wait a minute and try again.

text: Ada yang tidak beres di pihak kami. Silakan coba lagi.
english: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
back: Something went wrong on our side, please try again.

text: Layanan sedang tidak tersedia. Silakan coba lagi sebentar lagi.
english: The service is not available right now. Please try again shortly.
back: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

text: Ada yang tidak beres. Silakan coba lagi.
english: Something went wrong. Please try again.

text: Kunci sandi itu tidak ada di akun ini.
english: That passkey was not found on this account.
back: That password key isn't in this account.

text: Nama kelas harus terdiri atas 1 sampai 128 karakter.
english: A classroom name must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The class name must consist of 1 to 128 characters.

text: Kode gabung itu tidak valid. Kodenya terdiri atas 6 huruf.
english: That is not a valid join code. It has 6 letters.
back: The merge code is invalid. It consists of 6 characters.

text: Tidak ada kelas dengan kode itu. Tanyakan kepada gurumu.
english: No classroom has that code. Check it with your teacher.
back: There's no class with that code, ask your teacher.

english: You are not a member of this classroom.

text: Hanya guru yang dapat membuat tugas.
english: Only the teacher can create assignments.

text: Judul tugas harus terdiri atas 1 sampai 128 karakter.
english: An assignment title must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The task title must consist of 1 to 128 characters.

english: That is not a valid card.
The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.
back: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.

english: You do not own this card.
That listing is no longer open.

text: Kamu tidak bisa membeli penawaranmu sendiri.
english: You cannot buy your own listing.
back: You can't buy your own offer.

english: Registration for this tournament is closed.
back: Registration for this tournament is closed.

english: That match has already been decided.

text: Saat ini tidak ada musim yang berlangsung.
english: No season is running right now.
back: There's no season going on right now.

english: You have not reached that level yet.
That reward has already been claimed.
You do not have enough credits.

text: Kamu sudah mencapai batas belanja hari ini untuk pemain di bawah 18 tahun.
english: You have reached today's spending limit for players under 18.
back: You've reached today's spending limit for under-18 players.

english: You have already unlocked that variant.
That is not a valid invitation code.

text: Tidak ada undangan dengan kode itu.
back: There's no invitation with that code.

text: Kamu tidak bisa memakai kode undanganmu sendiri.
english: You cannot use your own invitation code.
back: You can't use your own invitation code.

text: Bagian halaman ini tidak dapat ditampilkan.
english: This part of the page could not be shown.
back: This part of the page cannot be displayed.

text: Beberapa bagian permainan memerlukan koneksi internet. Periksa koneksimu dan coba lagi.
english: Some parts of the game need an internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
back: Some parts of the game require an internet connection. Check your connection and try again.

english: Sonnet Man: the duel of verses

text: Permainan kartu adu rap ala Shakespeare dari Inspired Mile. Mainkan kartumu, jaga bentuknya, dan tulis lebih baik daripada lawan yang berjalan sepenuhnya di perangkatmu.
english: A Shakespeare rap-battle card game from Inspired Mile. Play your cards, keep the form, and out-write an opponent that runs entirely on your device.
back: Inspired Mile's Shakespeare-style rap duel card game. Play your cards, keep them in shape, and write better than an opponent who runs fully on your device.

text: Aplikasinya terbuka di layar penuh, dan di aplikasi yang terinstal, model yang sudah diunduh jauh lebih kecil kemungkinannya dihapus peramban.
english: It opens full screen, and an installed app is far less likely to have a downloaded model cleared by the browser.
back: The application opens in full screen, and in the installed application, downloaded models are much less likely to be deleted by the browser.

text: Di iPhone dan iPad, aplikasi di Layar Utama tidak berbagi apa pun dengan tab ini. Tambahkan sebelum kamu masuk atau mengunduh model, atau kamu harus melakukan keduanya dua kali.
english: On iPhone and iPad the Home Screen app shares nothing with this tab. Add it before you sign in or download a model, or you will do both twice.
back: On iPhone and iPad, apps on the Home Screen do not share anything with this tab. Add before you log in or download a model, or you will have to do both twice.

text: Tetap tersimpan di perangkat ini: 1,1 GB. Perambanmu tidak akan menghapusnya sendiri.
english: 1.1 GB kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: Remains on this device: 1.1 GB Your browser won't delete it by itself

text: Unduhanmu tetap tersimpan di perangkat ini. Perambanmu tidak akan menghapusnya sendiri.
english: Your download is kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: Your downloads will remain on this device. Your browser won't delete them by itself.

text: Disimpan di perangkat ini: 1,1 GB, tetapi perambanmu bisa menghapusnya jika ruang perangkat menipis atau kamu lama tidak kembali.
english: 1.1 GB stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: Stored on this device: 1.1 GB, but your browser can delete it if you run out of space or haven't been back for a long time.

text: Unduhanmu disimpan, tetapi perambanmu bisa menghapusnya jika ruang perangkat menipis atau kamu lama tidak kembali.
