english: Your download is stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: Your downloads are saved, but your browser can delete them if you run out of device space or haven't been back for a long time.

english: Installing the app helps keep it.

text: Saya telah membaca dan menyetujui Ketentuan Layanan dan Kebijakan Privasi, termasuk bagian tentang penggunaan di kelas dan untuk pendidikan serta tentang FERPA.
english: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy, including the sections on classroom and educational use and on FERPA.
back: I have read and agreed to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, including sections about classroom and educational use and about FERPA.

text: Ingin bermain? Sang Teater mementaskan seluruh duel di dalam headset-mu.
english: Want to play? The Theatre stages the whole duel in your headset.
back: The Theatre plays the entire duel in your headset.

text: 교사가 학급을 만들고, 셰익스피어 퀴즈와 도전 과제를 내고, 학생들의 진행 상황을 확인해요.
english: Teachers create classrooms, set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Teachers create classes, set Shakespeare quizzes and challenging assignments, and track students' progress.

text: 학급을 만들거나 학급에 참여하세요. 교사는 셰익스피어 퀴즈와 도전 과제를 내고 학생들의 진행 상황을 확인할 수 있어요.
english: Create or join a classroom. Teachers set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Create or join classes. Teachers can create Shakespeare quizzes and challenging assignments, and track students' progress.

text: 학급 모드는 학교에서 쓰도록 만들었어요. 계속하려면 역할을 선택하세요.
english: Classroom Mode is made for schools. Choose your role to continue.
back: Classroom mode was created for school use. Choose a role to continue.

english: Join a classroom that already exists

text: 저는 교사, 강사 또는 학교 관리자이며, 이 서비스를 학생들과 함께 사용할 권한이 있습니다.
english: I am a teacher, an instructor or a school administrator, and I am authorised to use this with my students.
back: I am a teacher, instructor or school administrator and have permission to use this service with my students.

text: 만 18세 미만 학생을 등록하기 전에 부모님이나 보호자의 동의를 받겠습니다.
english: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under 18.
back: We will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling students under the age of 18.

text: 학급에 참여하기 전에 다음 내용을 확인해 주세요.
english: Before you join a classroom, please confirm the following:
back: Before joining a class, please check the following:

text: 부모님 또는 법정 보호자가 제가 학교 공부에 Inspired Mile을 사용하는 것을 알고 있으며, 허락했습니다.
english: My parent or legal guardian knows I am using Inspired Mile for schoolwork and has given permission.
back: My parent or legal guardian knows that I am using Inspired Mile for school and has given me permission to do so.

english: My teacher has given me a join code for a classroom.
back: I received a class participation code from my teacher.

text: 선생님이 학급에서 저의 진행 상황과 활동을 볼 수 있다는 것을 이해합니다.
english: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and what I do in the classroom.
back: I understand that the teacher can see my progress and activities in class.

english: Enter a name for the classroom.
You have not joined a classroom yet.
Sign in to see your classrooms.
back: Please log in to view my class.

text: “학급 만들기”를 선택하고 “3학년 2반 영어”나 “처음 만나는 셰익스피어” 같은 이름을 지어 주세요. 학급마다 6글자 참여 코드가 따로 생겨요.
english: Choose “Create a classroom” and give it a name, such as “Period 3 English” or “Shakespeare 101”. Each classroom gets its own 6-letter join code.
back: Choose "Create Class" and give it a name, such as "3rd Grade 2nd English" or "Shakespeare for Beginners." Each class will have its own six-character entry code.

text: 학생들에게 6글자 코드를 알려 주세요. 학생은 “학생이에요”를 선택하고, 동의를 확인한 뒤 코드를 입력해요. 이메일 주소는 필요 없어요.
english: Give your students the 6-letter code. They choose “I am a student”, confirm the consent and enter the code. No email address is needed.
back: Give your students a six-character code. They select "I'm a student," confirm that they agree, and enter the code.

english: Post it on your learning platform

text: 학급에 과제를 만들어 주세요. 지식을 확인하는 셰익스피어 퀴즈, 빠진 낱말을 채우는 명언 도전 과제, 창의적 글쓰기를 위한 시 결투가 있어요.
english: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare trivia to check knowledge, quotation challenges to fill in the missing words, or a duel of verses for creative writing.
back: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare quizzes to check your knowledge, quote challenges to fill in missing words, and poetry duels for creative writing.

english: Fill in the missing words of famous quotations
back: Fill in the missing words from famous sayings

text: 세 라운드의 시 결투, 심판은 기기에서 이루어져요
english: A three-round duel of verses, judged on the device
back: Three rounds of poetry duels, judged on the machine.

text: 학생마다 무엇을 마쳤는지, 점수는 몇 점인지, 어떤 카드를 얻었는지 확인하세요. 데이터는 학급 안에만 있어요. 학생은 자기 진행 상황을, 선생님은 모두의 진행 상황을 볼 수 있어요.
english: See what each student has completed, their scores and the cards they have earned. The data stays inside the classroom: students see their own progress, and you see everyone's.
back: See what each student completed, how many points they scored, and which cards they got. The data is only in the classroom, so students can see their progress, and you can see everyone else's.

text: 학생의 진행 상황을 볼 수 있는 사람
english: Who can see a student's progress
back: Who can see the student's progress

text: 다른 플레이어와 셰익스피어 수집 카드를 사고 교환하세요.
english: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.
back: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.

text: 다른 플레이어와 카드를 사고 교환하세요. 중복 카드를 판매 매물로 올리거나, 없는 카드를 찾아보세요.
english: Buy and trade cards with other players. Offer your duplicates for sale, or find the cards you are missing.
back: Buy and trade cards with other players, put duplicate cards up for sale or find missing ones.
Sign in to buy a card.

text: 구매했어요. 이제 이 카드는 내 것이에요.
english: Bought. The card is now yours.
back: I bought it, and now this card is mine.

english: Sign in to see your listings.
back: Please log in to view my listings.

english: Cards wanted (card numbers, separated by commas)
back: Cards you want (card numbers separated by commas)

english: Enter a price of at least 1 credit.
back: Enter a price of 1 or more credits.

english: Sign in to create a listing.
back: Please log in to post a listing.

text: 시 결투 토너먼트에 참가해 우승을 겨뤄 보세요.
english: Enter tournaments of verse duels and play for the title.
back: Take part in a city duel tournament and fight for the title.

text: 대회에 참가해 시 솜씨를 보여 주세요. 싱글 엘리미네이션, 리그전 등 여러 방식이 있어요.
english: Enter organised competitions and show your command of verse. Single elimination, round robin and more.
back: Take part in competitions and show your poetry skills. There are many ways to compete, including single elimination and league matches.

text: 토너먼트를 선택하면 대진표를 볼 수 있어요.
english: Choose a tournament to see its bracket.
back: Select a tournament to see the table.

text: 아직 토너먼트가 없어요. 조금 뒤에 다시 확인해 주세요.
english: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.
back: There are no tournaments yet, please check back later.
Please log in to request participation.

english: The bracket has not been drawn yet.
back: The ballot hasn't been decided yet.

text: 시즌 패스 레벨을 올려 Inspired Mile의 보상을 잠금 해제하세요.
english: Raise the level of your Season Pass to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.
back: Level up your Season Pass to unlock Inspired Mile rewards.

text: 배틀, 퀴즈, 도전 과제를 플레이해 XP를 얻으세요. 레벨이 오를 때마다 카드, 크레딧, 칭호가 잠금 해제돼요.
english: Play battles, trivia and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.
back: Earn XP by playing battles, quizzes and challenges. Unlock cards, credits and titles as you level up.
I'm at the top of my game.

english: This season has no rewards yet.
back: There is no reward for this season.

text: 로그인하면 시즌 패스 진행 상황을 모든 기기에서 이어갈 수 있어요.
english: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on every device.
back: Sign in to keep track of your Season Pass progress on all your devices.

text: 카드의 3D 모델을 가우시안 스플랫이나 GLB 메시로 살펴보세요.
english: Look at the cards' 3D models, as Gaussian splats or as GLB meshes.
back: Explore the 3D model of your card with Gaussian flats or GLB meshes.

text: 카드를 3D 모델로 살펴보세요. 가우시안 스플랫과 GLB 메시를 전환할 수 있어요. 드래그하면 모델이 돌아가고, 스크롤하면 확대·축소돼요.
english: Explore your cards as 3D models. Switch between the Gaussian splat and the GLB mesh. Drag to turn the model, scroll to zoom.
back: View your map as a 3D model. You can switch between Gaussian flats and GLB meshes, rotate the model by dragging and zoom in or out by scrolling.

english: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.
back: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.

text: hamlet.ply 파일을 불러왔어요. 드래그하면 돌아가고, 스크롤하면 확대·축소돼요.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: I've loaded the hamlet.ply file. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom in and out.

text: hamlet.ply 파일을 낮은 화질로 불러왔어요. 드래그하면 돌아가고, 스크롤하면 확대·축소돼요.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply at reduced quality. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: I've loaded a hamlet.ply file in low quality. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom in and out.

english: Picture quality was lowered to keep the movement smooth.
back: We lowered the quality to make the movements smoother.
I have a GLB model: Hamlet

english: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
back: There is no GLB model of Hamlet.

english: The model could not be loaded.

back: I could not start the 3D viewer.

english: The GLB view could not be loaded.
back: Failed to load the GLB view.

text: Babylon.js로 그리는 가우시안 스플랫이에요. 사진처럼 사실적인 3D 이미지를 돌리고, 확대하고, 옮겨 보세요.
english: Gaussian splats drawn by Babylon.js. Turn, zoom and move around a lifelike 3D picture of the model.
back: Babylon.js Gaussian Splatter Rotate, zoom in and out of a 3D image like you'd see it in a picture.

text: model-viewer로 보여 주는 일반 메시예요. 휴대폰에서는 증강 현실로 모델을 내 방에 놓을 수 있어요.
english: An ordinary mesh shown with model-viewer. On a phone it can place the model in your room in augmented reality.
back: On a mobile phone, you can use augmented reality to place the model in your room.

text: 휴대폰의 GLB 보기에서 “AR로 보기”를 누르면 내 방에서 카드를 볼 수 있어요.
english: In the GLB view on a phone, tap “View in AR” to see the card in your room.
back: In the GLB view on your phone, you can tap "View in AR" to see cards in my room.

text: 가상 현실에서 나의 셰익스피어 카드 컬렉션 사이를 걸어 보세요.
english: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.
back: Walk through my collection of Shakespeare cards in virtual reality.

text: 컬렉션 사이를 3D로 걸어 보세요. WebXR로 Quest 3와 Vision Pro에서 작동하고, 컴퓨터에서는 마우스로 둘러볼 수 있어요.
english: Walk through your collection in 3D. It works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro through WebXR, and with a mouse on a computer.
back: WebXR works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro, and you can use your mouse to navigate around the collection in 3D.

text: 3D 갤러리를 불러왔어요. 드래그해서 둘러보고, 스크롤해서 확대·축소하세요.
english: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: We've loaded a 3D gallery. Drag to explore, scroll to zoom in and out.

text: VR 헤드셋을 찾지 못했어요. 갤러리를 3D로 보여 드려요.
english: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.
back: I can't find my VR headset. Let me show you the gallery in 3D.

text: 화면 모서리에 있는 VR 버튼을 사용하세요.
english: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
back: Use the VR button at the corner of your screen.
I could not start the 3D gallery.

text: 이 기기에서는 WebXR을 사용할 수 없어요. 갤러리를 3D로 보여 드려요. 드래그해서 둘러보고, 스크롤해서 확대·축소하세요.
english: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: WebXR is not supported on this device. Let's show you the gallery in 3D. Drag to navigate, scroll to zoom in and out.

text: 클릭한 채로 드래그해서 둘러보세요. 스크롤해서 확대·축소하세요. 카드를 클릭하면 선택돼요.
english: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click a card to select it.
back: Click and hold to drag around. Scroll to zoom in or out. Click a card to select it.

text: “VR 들어가기”를 누르면 안으로 들어가요. 컨트롤러로 이동하고 카드를 고르세요.
english: Press “Enter VR” to step inside. Use the controllers to move and to pick cards.
back: Press "Enter VR" to enter. Go to your controller and pick a card.

text: WebXR로 열려요. 카드를 바라보고 손가락을 집으면 선택돼요.
english: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select it.
back: Open in WebXR. Look at the card and pick it up with your finger.

text: 서버에 연결하지 못했어요. 연결을 확인하고 다시 시도해 주세요.
english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
back: Unable to connect to the server. Please check your connection and try again.

english: You are not allowed to do that.
back: You don't have permission to do this.

text: 방금 내용이 바뀌었어요. 페이지를 새로 고친 뒤 다시 시도해 주세요.
english: That has just changed. Refresh and try again.
back: The content has just changed. Please refresh the page and try again.

text: 처리하지 못했어요. 입력한 내용을 확인하고 다시 시도해 주세요.
english: That did not go through. Check what you entered and try again.
back: Unable to process. Please check your input and try again.

text: 요청이 너무 많아요. 1분 뒤에 다시 시도해 주세요.
english: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
back: Too many requests, please try again in 1 minute.

text: 저희 쪽에서 문제가 생겼어요. 다시 시도해 주세요.
english: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
back: There is a problem on our side, please try again.

text: 지금은 서비스를 이용할 수 없어요. 잠시 뒤에 다시 시도해 주세요.
english: The service is not available right now. Please try again shortly.
back: The service is currently unavailable, please try again later.

english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
back: We have a problem, please try again.

english: That passkey was not found on this account.
back: The passkey is not in this account.

english: A classroom name must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The class name must be between 1 and 128 characters.

text: 그 참여 코드는 올바르지 않아요. 코드는 6글자예요.
english: That is not a valid join code. It has 6 letters.
back: The participation code is incorrect, it's 6-character.

text: 그 코드의 학급이 없어요. 선생님께 확인해 보세요.
english: No classroom has that code. Check it with your teacher.
back: There's no class for that code, check with your teacher.

english: You are not a member of this classroom.
Only the teacher can create assignments.
back: Only the teacher can create assignments.

english: An assignment title must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The task title must be between 1 and 128 characters.

english: That is not a valid card.
The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.
back: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.

english: You do not own this card.
That listing is no longer open.

text: 내가 올린 매물은 구매할 수 없어요.
english: You cannot buy your own listing.
Registration for this tournament is closed.
back: Registration for this tournament is closed.

english: That match has already been decided.
No season is running right now.
You have not reached that level yet.
back: I haven't reached that level yet.

english: That reward has already been claimed.
You do not have enough credits.

text: 만 18세 미만 플레이어의 오늘 사용 한도에 도달했어요.
english: You have reached today's spending limit for players under 18.
back: You've reached the limit for players under 18 today.

english: You have already unlocked that variant.
That is not a valid invitation code.
back: The invitation code is not valid.
There's no invitation in that code.

text: 내 초대 코드는 내가 사용할 수 없어요.
english: You cannot use your own invitation code.
back: I can't use my invitation code.

english: This part of the page could not be shown.
back: We couldn't display this part of the page.

text: 게임의 일부는 인터넷 연결이 필요해요. 연결을 확인하고 다시 시도해 주세요.
english: Some parts of the game need an internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
back: Some games require an Internet connection, please check your connection and try again.

english: Sonnet Man: the duel of verses

text: Inspired Mile의 셰익스피어 배틀 랩 카드 게임. 카드를 내고, 형식을 지키고, 내 기기에서만 움직이는 상대보다 더 잘 써 보세요.
english: A Shakespeare rap-battle card game from Inspired Mile. Play your cards, keep the form, and out-write an opponent that runs entirely on your device.
back: Inspired Mile's Shakespeare Battle Lap card game. Deal cards, stick to format, and beat your opponent who moves only on your device.

text: 전체 화면으로 열리고, 설치한 앱에서는 내려받은 모델을 브라우저가 지울 가능성이 훨씬 낮아요.
english: It opens full screen, and an installed app is far less likely to have a downloaded model cleared by the browser.
back: It opens in full screen, and it's much less likely that your browser will delete the downloaded model from an installed app.

text: iPhone과 iPad에서는 홈 화면의 앱이 이 탭과 아무것도 공유하지 않아요. 로그인하거나 모델을 내려받기 전에 추가하세요. 그러지 않으면 두 가지를 모두 두 번 해야 해요.
english: On iPhone and iPad the Home Screen app shares nothing with this tab. Add it before you sign in or download a model, or you will do both twice.
back: On iPhone and iPad, apps on the Home screen don't share anything with this tab. Add them before you sign in or download a model, otherwise you'll have to do both twice.

text: 이 기기에 보관된 데이터: 1.1GB. 브라우저가 알아서 지우지 않아요.
english: 1.1 GB kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: Data stored on this device: 1.1GB. Your browser doesn't delete it automatically.

text: 내려받은 데이터가 이 기기에 보관되어 있어요. 브라우저가 알아서 지우지 않아요.
english: Your download is kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: Your downloaded data is stored on this device, and your browser doesn't delete it.

text: 이 기기에 저장된 데이터: 1.1GB. 하지만 기기 공간이 부족하거나 한동안 들어오지 않으면 브라우저가 지울 수 있어요.
english: 1.1 GB stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: Data stored on this device: 1.1GB, but if you run out of space on your device or haven't received data for a while, the browser can erase it.

text: 내려받은 데이터가 저장되어 있지만, 기기 공간이 부족하거나 한동안 들어오지 않으면 브라우저가 지울 수 있어요.
english: Your download is stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: Your downloaded data is stored, but if you run out of space on your device or don't receive it for a while, the browser can erase it.

text: 앱을 설치하면 보관하는 데 도움이 돼요.
english: Installing the app helps keep it.
back: Install an app to help you keep track.

text: 저는 서비스 약관 및 개인정보 처리방침을(를) 읽었으며, 수업 및 교육 목적의 이용과 FERPA에 관한 항목을 포함하여 이에 동의합니다.
english: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy, including the sections on classroom and educational use and on FERPA.
back: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, including sections relating to FERPA and use for classroom and educational purposes.

text: 플레이하고 싶나요? 더 극장에서는 결투 전체가 헤드셋 안에서 펼쳐져요.
english: Want to play? The Theatre stages the whole duel in your headset.
back: Want to play? With More Theatre, the entire duel unfolds inside your headset.

text: 教員がクラスを作り、シェイクスピアのクイズやチャレンジを出題して、生徒の進み具合を確認します。
english: Teachers create classrooms, set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: The teacher creates a class, asks Shakespeare quizzes and challenges, and checks the progress of the students.

text: クラスを作るか、クラスに参加してください。教員はシェイクスピアのクイズやチャレンジを出題し、生徒の進み具合を確認できます。
english: Create or join a classroom. Teachers set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Create or join a class. Teachers can assign Shakespeare quizzes and challenges, and check the progress of their students.

text: クラスモードは学校での利用を想定しています。続けるには、あなたの立場を選んでください。
english: Classroom Mode is made for schools. Choose your role to continue.
back: Class mode is intended for use in schools. Choose your position to continue.

text: クラスを作成・管理する
すでにあるクラスに参加する
english: Join a classroom that already exists

text: 私は教員、講師、または学校の管理職であり、このサービスを生徒と利用する権限があります。
english: I am a teacher, an instructor or a school administrator, and I am authorised to use this with my students.
back: I am a teacher, lecturer or school administrator and have permission to use this service with my students.

text: 18歳未満の生徒を登録する前に、親または保護者の同意を得ます。
english: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under 18.
back: Before enrolling students under the age of 18, the consent of a parent or guardian is obtained.

text: クラスに参加する前に、次のことを確認してください。
english: Before you join a classroom, please confirm the following:
back: Before joining the class, please make sure of the following:

text: 親または法定保護者は、私が学校の学習のためにInspired Mileを使うことを知っており、許可しています。
english: My parent or legal guardian knows I am using Inspired Mile for schoolwork and has given permission.
back: My parent or legal guardian knows that I'm using Inspired Mile for school learning and has given me permission.

text: 先生からクラスの参加コードをもらっています。
english: My teacher has given me a join code for a classroom.
back: The teacher has given me a code to join the class.

text: クラスでの私の進み具合や活動を先生が見られることを理解しています。
english: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and what I do in the classroom.
back: I understand that the teacher can see my progress and activities in class.

text: 6文字の参加コードを入力してください。
クラス名を入力してください。
english: Enter a name for the classroom.

text: クラスを作成しました。
まだどのクラスにも参加していません。
english: You have not joined a classroom yet.
back: You haven't joined any classes yet.

text: クラスを見るにはサインインしてください。
english: Sign in to see your classrooms.
back: You must sign in to view the class.

text: 課題はまだありません。
「クラスを作成」を選び、「3年B組の英語」や「はじめてのシェイクスピア」のような名前を付けます。クラスごとに、6文字の参加コードが発行されます。
english: Choose “Create a classroom” and give it a name, such as “Period 3 English” or “Shakespeare 101”. Each classroom gets its own 6-letter join code.
back: Choose "Create Class" and give it a name such as "3rd Grade B English" or "Shakespeare for Beginners". A six-character enrollment code will be issued for each class.

text: 生徒に6文字のコードを伝えます。生徒は「生徒です」を選び、同意を確認して、コードを入力します。メールアドレスは必要ありません。
english: Give your students the 6-letter code. They choose “I am a student”, confirm the consent and enter the code. No email address is needed.
back: Give the student a 6-character code. The student selects "I am a student", agrees, and enters the code. An email address is not required.

text: 学習支援システムに掲示する
english: Post it on your learning platform
back: The results are published in a learning support system.

text: クラスに課題を出しましょう。知識を確かめるシェイクスピアクイズ、抜けている言葉を埋める名言チャレンジ、創作のための詩の決闘があります。
english: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare trivia to check knowledge, quotation challenges to fill in the missing words, or a duel of verses for creative writing.
back: Give the class assignments. There are Shakespeare tricks to check your knowledge, quote challenges to fill in missing words, and poetry duels for creativity.

text: シェイクスピアについての選択式の問題5問
有名な名言の抜けている言葉を埋める
english: Fill in the missing words of famous quotations
back: Fill in the missing words of famous sayings.

text: 3ラウンドの詩の決闘。審判は端末の中で行われます
english: A three-round duel of verses, judged on the device
back: Three rounds of poetry duel. The judgment will take place inside the terminal.

text: 生徒一人ひとりが何を終えたか、得点、手に入れたカードを確認できます。データはクラスの外に出ません。生徒には自分の進み具合が、あなたには全員の進み具合が見えます。
english: See what each student has completed, their scores and the cards they have earned. The data stays inside the classroom: students see their own progress, and you see everyone's.
back: You can see what each student has completed, their scores, and the cards they have received. The data never leaves the classroom. Students can see their progress and you can see everyone else's progress.

text: 生徒の進み具合を見られる人
english: Who can see a student's progress
back: People who can see the progress of their students .

text: ほかのプレイヤーとシェイクスピアのコレクションカードを売買・交換できます。
english: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.
back: You can trade and exchange Shakespeare collection cards with other players.

text: ほかのプレイヤーとカードを売買・交換できます。重複したカードを出品したり、足りないカードを探したりしましょう。
english: Buy and trade cards with other players. Offer your duplicates for sale, or find the cards you are missing.
back: You can trade and exchange cards with other players. Put up duplicate cards, or look for missing ones.

text: 出品が見つかりません。
カードを購入するにはサインインしてください。
back: You must sign in to buy a card.

text: 購入しました。カードはあなたのものです。
english: Bought. The card is now yours.
back: I bought it. The card is yours.

text: 自分の出品を見るにはサインインしてください。
english: Sign in to see your listings.
back: Please sign in to view your listings.

text: 出品するカードを選択…
希望するカード（カード番号をカンマで区切る）
english: Cards wanted (card numbers, separated by commas)
back: Cards you want (card numbers separated by commas)

text: カードを選んでください。
1クレジット以上の価格を入力してください。
english: Enter a price of at least 1 credit.
back: Please enter a price of more than 1 credit.

text: 出品するにはサインインしてください。
english: Sign in to create a listing.
back: Please sign in to post a listing.

text: 詩の決闘のトーナメントに参加して、タイトルを目指しましょう。
english: Enter tournaments of verse duels and play for the title.
back: Let's take part in the poetry duel tournament and aim for the title.

text: 大会に参加して、詩の腕前を見せましょう。ノックアウト方式、総当たり戦などがあります。
english: Enter organised competitions and show your command of verse. Single elimination, round robin and more.
back: Let's take part in the competition and show your poetry skills. There are knock-out contests, all-out contests and so on.

text: トーナメントを選ぶと、トーナメント表が表示されます。
english: Choose a tournament to see its bracket.
back: When you select a tournament, the tournament table is displayed.

text: トーナメントはまだありません。また後で確認してください。
english: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.
back: There is no tournament yet. Please check again later.

text: トーナメント表を見る
参加登録するにはサインインしてください。
参加登録が完了しました。
トーナメント表を読み込んでいます…
トーナメント表の組み合わせは、まだ決まっていません。
english: The bracket has not been drawn yet.
back: The combination of the tournament table has not been decided yet.

text: シーズンパスのレベルを上げて、Inspired Mileの報酬を解除しましょう。
english: Raise the level of your Season Pass to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.
back: Let's level up the season pass and unlock the Inspired Mile reward.

text: バトル、クイズ、チャレンジをプレイしてXPを獲得しましょう。レベルが上がるたびに、カード、クレジット、称号が解除されます。
english: Play battles, trivia and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.
back: Earn XP by playing battles, quizzes and challenges. Cards, credits and titles are unlocked every time you level up.

text: 次のレベルまであと 150 XP
最高レベルに到達しました
このシーズンの報酬はまだありません。
english: This season has no rewards yet.
back: There is no reward for this season yet.

text: サインインすると、シーズンパスの進行状況をどの端末でも引き継げます。
english: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on every device.
back: When you sign in, you can take your season pass progress on any device.

text: カードの3Dモデルを、ガウシアン・スプラッティングまたはGLBメッシュで表示します。
english: Look at the cards' 3D models, as Gaussian splats or as GLB meshes.
back: Displays a 3D model of the card with Gaussian splitting or GLB meshes.

text: カードを3Dモデルで見てみましょう。ガウシアン・スプラッティングとGLBメッシュを切り替えられます。ドラッグでモデルを回転、スクロールで拡大・縮小します。
english: Explore your cards as 3D models. Switch between the Gaussian splat and the GLB mesh. Drag to turn the model, scroll to zoom.
back: Let's look at the card in a 3D model. You can switch between Gaussian splitting and GLB meshes. Drag to rotate the model, scroll to zoom in or out.

text: 3Dビューアを起動しています…
3Dビューアの準備ができました。カードを選んでください。
english: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.
back: You are ready for the 3D viewer. Please select a card.

text: モデルを読み込んでいます…
hamlet.ply を読み込みました。ドラッグで回転、スクロールで拡大・縮小します。
english: Loaded hamlet.ply. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: hamlet.ply loaded. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom in and out.

text: hamlet.ply を画質を下げて読み込みました。ドラッグで回転、スクロールで拡大・縮小します。
english: Loaded hamlet.ply at reduced quality. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: Loaded hamlet.ply in lower quality. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom in and out.

text: 動きを滑らかに保つため、画質を下げました。
english: Picture quality was lowered to keep the movement smooth.
back: The image quality has been reduced to keep the movement smooth.

text: GLBモデルを読み込みました：Hamlet
Hamlet のGLBモデルはありません。
english: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.

text: ファイルにモデルが含まれていません。
back: The file does not contain a model.

text: モデルを読み込めませんでした。
english: The model could not be loaded.

text: 3Dビューアを起動できませんでした。
GLB表示を読み込めませんでした。
english: The GLB view could not be loaded.

text: Babylon.jsで描画するガウシアン・スプラッティングです。写真のようにリアルな3D画像を、回転・拡大・移動できます。
english: Gaussian splats drawn by Babylon.js. Turn, zoom and move around a lifelike 3D picture of the model.
back: Gaussian splicing drawn in Babylon.js. You can rotate, zoom and move realistic 3D images like photos.

text: model-viewerで表示する通常のメッシュです。スマートフォンでは、拡張現実でモデルを部屋に置けます。
english: An ordinary mesh shown with model-viewer. On a phone it can place the model in your room in augmented reality.
back: This is the normal mesh displayed by model-viewer. On smartphones, you can place models in rooms with augmented reality.

text: スマートフォンのGLB表示で「ARで見る」をタップすると、カードを自分の部屋で見られます。
english: In the GLB view on a phone, tap “View in AR” to see the card in your room.
back: If you tap "See in AR" on the GLB display of your smartphone, you can see the card in your room.

text: シェイクスピアのカードコレクションの中を、バーチャルリアリティで歩けます。
english: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.
back: You can walk through Shakespeare's card collection in virtual reality.

text: バーチャルリアリティ
コレクションの中を3Dで歩いてみましょう。WebXRによりQuest 3とVision Proで動作し、パソコンではマウスで操作できます。
english: Walk through your collection in 3D. It works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro through WebXR, and with a mouse on a computer.
back: Walk through your collection in 3D. WebXR runs on Quest 3 and Vision Pro, and you can control it with the mouse on a PC.

text: 3Dエンジンを読み込んでいます…
3Dギャラリーを読み込みました。ドラッグで見回し、スクロールで拡大・縮小します。
english: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: The 3D gallery has been loaded. Drag to view and scroll to zoom in or out.

text: VRヘッドセットが見つかりません。ギャラリーを3Dで表示します。
english: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.
back: No VR headset found. Show the gallery in 3D.

text: WebXRの準備ができました。「VRに入る」を押してください。
back: You are ready for WebXR. Click "Enter VR".

text: 画面の隅にあるVRボタンを使ってください。
english: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
back: Use the VR button in the corner of the screen.

text: ここではWebXRを利用できません。
3Dギャラリーを起動できませんでした。
この端末ではWebXRを利用できません。ギャラリーを3Dで表示します。ドラッグで見回し、スクロールで拡大・縮小します。
english: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: WebXR is not supported on this device. Show the gallery in 3D. Drag to view, scroll to zoom.

text: クリックしたままドラッグして見回します。スクロールで拡大・縮小します。カードをクリックすると選択できます。
english: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click a card to select it.
back: Click and drag to view. Scroll to zoom in or out. Click on a card to select it.

text: 「VRに入る」を押すと中に入れます。コントローラーで移動し、カードを選びます。
english: Press “Enter VR” to step inside. Use the controllers to move and to pick cards.
back: Press "Enter VR" to enter. Move with the controller and choose a card.

text: WebXRで開きます。カードを見て、指でつまむと選択できます。
english: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select it.
back: Open in WebXR. Look at the card and pick with your finger.

text: サーバーに接続できませんでした。接続を確認して、もう一度お試しください。
english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
back: Could not connect to the server. Please check your connection and try again.

text: 先にサインインしてください。
この操作を行う権限がありません。
english: You are not allowed to do that.
back: You do not have permission to perform this operation.

text: 見つかりませんでした。
内容が変更されたところです。ページを更新して、もう一度お試しください。
english: That has just changed. Refresh and try again.
back: The content has just been changed. Please refresh the page and try again.

text: 処理できませんでした。入力内容を確認して、もう一度お試しください。
english: That did not go through. Check what you entered and try again.
back: Could not process. Please check your input and try again.

text: リクエストが多すぎます。1分ほど待ってから、もう一度お試しください。
english: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
back: There are too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.

text: こちらで問題が発生しました。もう一度お試しください。
english: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
back: There was a problem here. Please try again.

text: 現在サービスを利用できません。しばらくしてから、もう一度お試しください。
english: The service is not available right now. Please try again shortly.
back: The service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

text: 問題が発生しました。もう一度お試しください。
english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
back: There was a problem. Please try again.

text: そのパスキーはこのアカウントにありません。
english: That passkey was not found on this account.
back: The passkey is not in this account.

text: クラス名は1～128文字で入力してください。
english: A classroom name must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The class name must be between 1 and 128 characters.

text: その参加コードは正しくありません。コードは6文字です。
english: That is not a valid join code. It has 6 letters.
back: The participation code is incorrect. It is 6 characters long.

text: そのコードのクラスはありません。先生に確認してください。
english: No classroom has that code. Check it with your teacher.
back: There is no class for this code. Please check with your teacher.

text: あなたはこのクラスのメンバーではありません。
english: You are not a member of this classroom.
back: You are not a member of this class.

text: 課題を作成できるのは教員だけです。
english: Only the teacher can create assignments.

text: 課題のタイトルは1～128文字で入力してください。
english: An assignment title must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The title of the task must be between 1 and 128 characters.

text: そのカードは正しくありません。
english: That is not a valid card.

text: 価格は1～100,000クレジットの範囲で入力してください。
english: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.
back: Please enter a price from 1 to 100,000 credits.

text: このカードを持っていません。
english: You do not own this card.

text: その出品はもうありません。
back: That item is no longer listed.

text: その出品は受付を終了しています。
english: That listing is no longer open.

text: 自分の出品を購入することはできません。
english: You cannot buy your own listing.
back: You can't buy your own listing.

text: そのトーナメントはもうありません。
このトーナメントの参加受付は終了しました。
english: Registration for this tournament is closed.
back: Registration for this tournament is closed.

text: このトーナメントは満員です。
その試合はもうありません。
その試合はすでに決着がついています。
english: That match has already been decided.

text: 現在開催中のシーズンはありません。
english: No season is running right now.

text: まだそのレベルに達していません。
english: You have not reached that level yet.
back: I haven't reached that level yet.

text: その報酬はすでに受け取り済みです。
english: That reward has already been claimed.
back: The reward has already been received.

text: クレジットが足りません。
english: You do not have enough credits.

text: 18歳未満のプレイヤーの、本日の利用上限に達しました。
english: You have reached today's spending limit for players under 18.
back: You have reached the maximum usage limit for players under 18 today.

text: そのバリアントはすでに解除済みです。
english: You have already unlocked that variant.
back: That variant has already been deactivated.

text: その招待コードは正しくありません。
english: That is not a valid invitation code.
back: The invitation code is not correct.

text: そのコードの招待はありません。
back: There is no invitation for that code.

text: 自分の招待コードは使えません。
english: You cannot use your own invitation code.
back: You cannot use your own invitation code.

text: ページのこの部分を表示できませんでした。
english: This part of the page could not be shown.
back: Could not display this part of the page.

text: ゲームの一部は、インターネット接続が必要です。接続を確認して、もう一度お試しください。
english: Some parts of the game need an internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
back: Some games require an Internet connection. Please check your connection and try again.

text: オフラインでも使えます

english: Sonnet Man: the duel of verses

text: Inspired Mileのシェイクスピア風MCバトル・カードゲーム。カードを出し、詩形を守り、あなたの端末だけで動く対戦相手よりも良い詩を書きましょう。
english: A Shakespeare rap-battle card game from Inspired Mile. Play your cards, keep the form, and out-write an opponent that runs entirely on your device.
back: Inspired Mile's Shakespearean-style MC battle card game. Turn cards, defend the poetry form and write a better poem than your opponent who moves only with your device.

text: まずSonnet Manをインストールしてください
全画面で開きます。インストールしたアプリでは、ダウンロードしたモデルがブラウザに消去されることがずっと少なくなります。
english: It opens full screen, and an installed app is far less likely to have a downloaded model cleared by the browser.
back: Opens in full screen mode. With installed applications, the downloaded models are much less likely to be deleted by the browser.

text: iPhoneとiPadでは、ホーム画面のアプリはこのタブと何も共有しません。サインインやモデルのダウンロードの前に追加してください。そうしないと、どちらも二度行うことになります。
english: On iPhone and iPad the Home Screen app shares nothing with this tab. Add it before you sign in or download a model, or you will do both twice.
back: On iPhone and iPad, apps on the home screen do not share anything with this tab. Add them before signing in or downloading a model, otherwise you will have to do both twice.

text: 共有ボタンをタップします。
「ホーム画面に追加」を選びます。
この端末に1.1 GBを保持しています。ブラウザが勝手に消去することはありません。
english: 1.1 GB kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: You are keeping 1.1 GB on this terminal. The browser will not delete it by itself.

text: ダウンロードしたデータはこの端末に保持されています。ブラウザが勝手に消去することはありません。
english: Your download is kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: The downloaded data is kept on this device. Your browser will not delete it by itself.

text: この端末に1.1 GBを保存していますが、端末の空き容量が足りなくなったり、しばらくアクセスしなかったりすると、ブラウザが消去することがあります。
english: 1.1 GB stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: You have saved 1.1 GB on this device, but your browser may delete it if you run out of space on the device or if you do not access it for a while.

text: ダウンロードしたデータは保存されていますが、端末の空き容量が足りなくなったり、しばらくアクセスしなかったりすると、ブラウザが消去することがあります。
english: Your download is stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: The downloaded data is saved, but the browser may delete it if you run out of free space on your device or have not accessed it for a while.

text: アプリをインストールすると残りやすくなります。
english: Installing the app helps keep it.
back: Installing an app makes it easier to stay.

text: 私は利用規約とプライバシーポリシーを、授業・教育目的での利用とFERPAに関する項目を含めて読み、同意します。
english: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy, including the sections on classroom and educational use and on FERPA.
back: I have read and agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, including the section on Classroom/Educational Use and FERPA.

text: プレイしたいときは、立体シアターへ。決闘のすべてがヘッドセットの中で上演されます。
english: Want to play? The Theatre stages the whole duel in your headset.
back: When you want to play, go to the 3D theatre. All the duels are played in your headset.

text: トーナメントアリーナ
教师创建班级，布置莎士比亚问答和挑战，并查看学生的学习进度。
english: Teachers create classrooms, set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Teachers create classes, set up Shakespearean questions and challenges, and monitor students ' learning progress.

text: 创建班级或加入班级。教师布置莎士比亚问答和挑战，并查看学生的学习进度。
english: Create or join a classroom. Teachers set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Create or join classes. Teachers set up Shakespeare Q&A and challenges, and view students' learning progress.

text: 课堂模式专为学校使用而设计。请选择你的身份以继续。
english: Classroom Mode is made for schools. Choose your role to continue.
back: Classroom mode is designed for school use. Please select your identity to continue.

english: Join a classroom that already exists

text: 我是教师、培训讲师或学校管理人员，并有权与我的学生一起使用本服务。
english: I am a teacher, an instructor or a school administrator, and I am authorised to use this with my students.
back: I am a teacher, training instructor or school administrator and have the right to use this service with my students.

text: 在让任何未满 18 岁的学生加入之前，我会先取得其父母或监护人的同意。
english: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under 18.
back: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before allowing any student under 18 to join.

text: 加入班级之前，请确认以下内容：
english: Before you join a classroom, please confirm the following:
back: Before joining the class, please confirm the following:

text: 我的父母或法定监护人知道我在用 Inspired Mile 完成学校功课，并已同意。
english: My parent or legal guardian knows I am using Inspired Mile for schoolwork and has given permission.
back: My parent or legal guardian knows that I am using Inspired Mile to complete my homework and has consented.

text: 老师已经给了我班级的加入码。
english: My teacher has given me a join code for a classroom.
back: The teacher has already given me the enrollment code for my class.

text: 我明白老师可以看到我在班级里的进度和活动。
english: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and what I do in the classroom.
back: I understand that the teacher can see my progress and activities in class.

text: 请输入 6 位字母的加入码。
back: Please enter a 6-digit letter join code.

english: Enter a name for the classroom.

text: 你还没有加入任何班级。
english: You have not joined a classroom yet.
back: You have not joined any classes yet.

text: 登录后即可查看你的班级。
english: Sign in to see your classrooms.
back: Log in to view your classes.

text: 选择“创建班级”并为它起个名字，例如“九年级（2）班英语”或“莎士比亚入门”。每个班级都有自己的 6 位字母加入码。
english: Choose “Create a classroom” and give it a name, such as “Period 3 English” or “Shakespeare 101”. Each classroom gets its own 6-letter join code.
back: Choose "Create Class" and give it a name, such as "Grade 9 (2) English Class" or "Shakespeare Introduction." Each class has its own six-digit alphabetic join code.

text: 把 6 位字母的加入码告诉学生。他们选择“我是学生”，确认同意，然后输入加入码。无需电子邮箱。
english: Give your students the 6-letter code. They choose “I am a student”, confirm the consent and enter the code. No email address is needed.
back: Give students a six-digit enrollment code. They select “I’m a student,” confirm that they agree, and then enter the enrollment code.

english: Post it on your learning platform

text: 为你的班级创建作业：检验知识的莎士比亚问答、补全缺失词语的名句挑战，或用于创意写作的诗歌对决。
english: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare trivia to check knowledge, quotation challenges to fill in the missing words, or a duel of verses for creative writing.
back: Create assignments for your class: Shakespearean quizzes to test knowledge, phrase challenges to fill in missing words, or poetry duels for creative writing.

text: 5 道关于莎士比亚的选择题
补全名句中缺失的词语
english: Fill in the missing words of famous quotations
back: Completing missing words in substantive sentences

text: 三个回合的诗歌对决，在设备上评判
english: A three-round duel of verses, judged on the device
back: Three rounds of poetry duels, judged on equipment

text: 查看每位学生完成了什么、得了多少分、赢得了哪些卡牌。数据只留在班级内：学生只能看到自己的进度，你可以看到所有人的进度。
english: See what each student has completed, their scores and the cards they have earned. The data stays inside the classroom: students see their own progress, and you see everyone's.
back: See what each student has accomplished, how many points they have scored, and which cards they have won. The data remains within the class: students only see their own progress; you can see everyone else’s.

text: 谁可以看到学生的进度
english: Who can see a student's progress

text: 与其他玩家买卖和交换莎士比亚收藏卡牌。
english: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.
back: Trade and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.

text: 与其他玩家买卖和交换卡牌。把重复的卡牌挂出来出售，或者找到你缺少的卡牌。
english: Buy and trade cards with other players. Offer your duplicates for sale, or find the cards you are missing.
back: Trade and trade cards with other players. Hang up duplicate cards to sell, or find the ones you're missing.
You must be logged in to purchase cards.

text: 购买成功。这张卡牌现在是你的了。
english: Bought. The card is now yours.
back: The purchase was successful. This card is now yours.

text: 登录后即可查看你的挂单。
english: Sign in to see your listings.
back: Log in to view your pending orders.
Choose the cards you want to hang...

text: 想要的卡牌（卡牌编号，用逗号分隔）
english: Cards wanted (card numbers, separated by commas)
back: Cards desired (card numbers separated by commas)

text: 请输入不低于 1 点的价格。
english: Enter a price of at least 1 credit.
back: Please enter a price of at least 1 point.
The pending order has been created.

english: Sign in to create a listing.
back: You must log in to create a pending order.

text: 参加诗歌对决锦标赛，争夺冠军头衔。
english: Enter tournaments of verse duels and play for the title.
back: Participate in a poetry contest and win the title.

text: 参加有组织的比赛，展示你驾驭诗句的功力。单败淘汰制、循环赛，还有更多赛制。
english: Enter organised competitions and show your command of verse. Single elimination, round robin and more.
back: Take part in organized competitions and show your poetry skills. There are elimination games, round robins, and more.

text: 选择一项锦标赛以查看它的对阵表。
english: Choose a tournament to see its bracket.
back: Select a tournament to see its schedule.

text: 目前还没有锦标赛。请过些时候再来看看。
english: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.
back: There are no tournaments at the moment. Please check back later.
You must be logged in to register.

english: The bracket has not been drawn yet.
back: The draw has not yet been generated.

text: 提升赛季通行证的等级，解锁 Inspired Mile 的奖励。
english: Raise the level of your Season Pass to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.
back: Level up your Season Pass to unlock Inspired Mile rewards.

text: 参加对战、问答和挑战来获得 XP。每升一级都会解锁卡牌、点数和称号。
english: Play battles, trivia and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.
back: Earn XP by taking part in battles, quizzes and challenges. Each level unlocks cards, points and titles.
Not far from the next level 150 XP

english: This season has no rewards yet.
back: There are no rewards for this season.

text: 登录后，你的赛季通行证进度会保存在所有设备上。
english: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on every device.
back: After signing in, your Season Pass progress will be saved on all devices.

text: 以高斯泼溅或 GLB 网格的形式查看卡牌的 3D 模型。
english: Look at the cards' 3D models, as Gaussian splats or as GLB meshes.
back: View 3D models of cards in the form of Gaussian splashes or GLB grids.

text: 以 3D 模型的形式欣赏你的卡牌。可在高斯泼溅和 GLB 网格之间切换。拖动可旋转模型，滚动可缩放。
english: Explore your cards as 3D models. Switch between the Gaussian splat and the GLB mesh. Drag to turn the model, scroll to zoom.
back: Enjoy your cards as a 3D model. Switch between Gaussian Splash and GLB grids. Drag to rotate the model, scroll to scale.

text: 3D 查看器已就绪。请选择一张卡牌。
english: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.
back: The 3D viewer is ready. Please select a card.

text: 已加载 hamlet.ply。拖动可旋转，滚动可缩放。
english: Loaded hamlet.ply. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: Hamlet.ply has been loaded. Drag to rotate, scroll to scale.

text: 已用较低画质加载 hamlet.ply。拖动可旋转，滚动可缩放。
english: Loaded hamlet.ply at reduced quality. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: Hamlet.ply has been loaded in lower quality. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.

text: 已降低画质，以保持画面流畅。
english: Picture quality was lowered to keep the movement smooth.
back: The image quality has been reduced to maintain smoothness.

text: Hamlet 没有 GLB 模型。
english: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
back: Hamlet does not have a GLB model.
There is no model in the file.

english: The model could not be loaded.

back: The 3D viewer could not be started.

english: The GLB view could not be loaded.
back: The GLB view failed to load.

text: 由 Babylon.js 绘制的高斯泼溅。可以旋转、缩放、平移这幅逼真的 3D 模型图像。
english: Gaussian splats drawn by Babylon.js. Turn, zoom and move around a lifelike 3D picture of the model.
back: Gaussian splash drawn by Babylon.js. Rotate, scale and pan this realistic 3D model image.

text: 用 model-viewer 显示的普通网格。在手机上，它可以通过增强现实把模型放进你的房间。
english: An ordinary mesh shown with model-viewer. On a phone it can place the model in your room in augmented reality.
back: The model-viewer displays an ordinary grid. On a mobile phone, it can put the model into your room through augmented reality.

text: 在手机的 GLB 视图中点按“用 AR 查看”，就能在你的房间里看到卡牌。
english: In the GLB view on a phone, tap “View in AR” to see the card in your room.
back: Tap "View with AR" in the GLB view on your phone to see cards in your room.

text: 在虚拟现实中漫步于你的莎士比亚卡牌收藏。
english: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.
back: Walk through your Shakespearean card collection in virtual reality.

text: 以 3D 方式漫步于你的收藏。可通过 WebXR 在 Quest 3 和 Vision Pro 上使用，也可以在电脑上用鼠标浏览。
english: Walk through your collection in 3D. It works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro through WebXR, and with a mouse on a computer.
back: Walk through your collection in 3D. Available via WebXR on Quest 3 and Vision Pro, or browse with the mouse on a computer.

text: 3D 展厅已加载。拖动可环顾四周，滚动可缩放。
english: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: The 3D gallery has been loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom in.

text: 未检测到 VR 头显。展厅将以 3D 方式显示。
english: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.
back: No VR headsets detected. The showroom will be displayed in 3D.

text: WebXR 已就绪。请按“进入 VR”。
请使用画面角落的 VR 按钮。
english: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
back: Use the VR button in the corner of the screen.
The 3D Gallery could not be started.

text: 这台设备无法使用 WebXR。展厅将以 3D 方式显示：拖动可环顾四周，滚动可缩放。
english: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: This device is not compatible with WebXR. The exhibition hall will be displayed in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.

text: 按住并拖动可环顾四周。滚动可缩放。点击卡牌即可选中。
english: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click a card to select it.
back: Hold and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click on a card to select it.

text: 按“进入 VR”即可置身其中。用手柄移动并挑选卡牌。
english: Press “Enter VR” to step inside. Use the controllers to move and to pick cards.
back: Press "Enter VR" to enter it. Use the joystick to move and pick cards.

text: 通过 WebXR 打开。看着一张卡牌，然后捏合即可选中。
english: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select it.
back: Opened via WebXR. Look at a card, then pinch to select.

text: 无法连接服务器。请检查网络后再试。
english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
back: Unable to connect to the server. Please check your network and try again.

english: You are not allowed to do that.
back: You have no permission to do this.

text: 内容刚刚发生了变化。请刷新页面后再试。
english: That has just changed. Refresh and try again.
back: Content has just changed. Please refresh the page and try again.

text: 操作没有成功。请检查你输入的内容后再试。
english: That did not go through. Check what you entered and try again.
back: Please check the URL you entered and try again.

text: 请求太频繁。请等一分钟后再试。
english: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
back: Requests are too frequent. Please wait a minute.

text: 我们这边出了点问题。请再试一次。
english: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
back: We have a problem here. Please try again.

text: 服务暂时不可用。请稍后再试。
english: The service is not available right now. Please try again shortly.
back: The page you are looking for is temporarily unavailable.

text: 出了点问题。请再试一次。
english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
back: There was a problem. Please try again.

text: 这个账户里没有这把通行密钥。
english: That passkey was not found on this account.
back: This account does not have this passkey.

text: 班级名称须为 1 到 128 个字符。
english: A classroom name must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The class name must be between 1 and 128 characters.

text: 这个加入码无效。加入码由 6 个字母组成。
english: That is not a valid join code. It has 6 letters.
back: This add-on code is invalid. The add-on code consists of 6 letters.

text: 没有班级使用这个加入码。请向老师核对。
english: No classroom has that code. Check it with your teacher.
back: There are no classes using this enrollment code. Please check with your teacher.

text: 你不是这个班级的成员。
english: You are not a member of this classroom.
back: You are not a member of this class.

text: 只有教师可以创建作业。
english: Only the teacher can create assignments.

text: 作业标题须为 1 到 128 个字符。
english: An assignment title must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: Job titles must be 1 to 128 characters long.

english: That is not a valid card.

text: 价格须在 1 到 100,000 点之间。
english: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.
back: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 points.

english: You do not own this card.
That listing is no longer open.

text: 你不能购买自己的挂单。
english: You cannot buy your own listing.
back: You cannot buy your own pending orders.

text: 这项锦标赛的报名已截止。
english: Registration for this tournament is closed.
back: Registration for this tournament is closed.

text: 这项锦标赛的名额已满。
这场比赛已经分出胜负。
english: That match has already been decided.
back: The match has already been drawn.

text: 目前没有正在进行的赛季。
english: No season is running right now.
back: There is currently no ongoing season.

text: 你还没有达到这个等级。
english: You have not reached that level yet.
back: You have not reached this level yet.

text: 这份奖励已经领取过了。
english: That reward has already been claimed.
back: This award has already been collected.

english: You do not have enough credits.

text: 你已达到未满 18 岁玩家今天的消费上限。
english: You have reached today's spending limit for players under 18.
back: You've reached the under 18 limit for today.

text: 你已经解锁过这个变体了。
english: You have already unlocked that variant.
back: You have already unlocked this variant.

english: That is not a valid invitation code.

text: 没有使用这个邀请码的邀请。
back: There are no invitations for this invitation code.

text: 你不能使用自己的邀请码。
english: You cannot use your own invitation code.
back: You cannot use your own invitation code.

text: 页面的这一部分无法显示。
english: This part of the page could not be shown.
back: This part of the page cannot be displayed.

text: 游戏的部分内容需要联网。请检查网络后再试。
english: Some parts of the game need an internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
back: Some content in the game requires a network connection. Please check your network and try again.

english: Sonnet Man: the duel of verses

text: Inspired Mile 出品的莎士比亚说唱对战卡牌游戏。打出你的卡牌，守住诗体，写得比完全运行在你设备上的对手更好。
english: A Shakespeare rap-battle card game from Inspired Mile. Play your cards, keep the form, and out-write an opponent that runs entirely on your device.
back: Shakespearean rap battle card game by Inspired Mile. Play your cards, keep the poetry, and write better than an opponent who runs completely on your device.

text: 它会全屏打开，而且在已安装的应用中，下载的模型被浏览器清除的可能性要小得多。
english: It opens full screen, and an installed app is far less likely to have a downloaded model cleared by the browser.
back: It opens full-screen, and in installed applications it is much less likely that the downloaded model will be deleted by the browser.

text: 在 iPhone 和 iPad 上，主屏幕上的应用与这个标签页不共享任何内容。请在登录或下载模型之前添加它，否则这两件事都得做两遍。
english: On iPhone and iPad the Home Screen app shares nothing with this tab. Add it before you sign in or download a model, or you will do both twice.
back: On iPhone and iPad, apps on the home screen do not share anything with this tab. Please add it before logging in or downloading a model, otherwise you will have to do both twice.

text: 已在这台设备上保留 1.1 GB。浏览器不会自行清除。
english: 1.1 GB kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: 1.1 GB has been retained on this device. The browser will not clear itself.

text: 你下载的内容已保留在这台设备上。浏览器不会自行清除。
english: Your download is kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: Your downloads have been retained on this device. The browser will not delete them by itself.

text: 已在这台设备上存储 1.1 GB，但如果设备空间不足，或你一段时间没有回来，浏览器可能会清除这些内容。
english: 1.1 GB stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: There is already 1.1 GB stored on this device, but if the device runs out of space or you haven't returned for a while, the browser may clear these contents.

text: 你下载的内容已存储，但如果设备空间不足，或你一段时间没有回来，浏览器可能会清除这些内容。
english: Your download is stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: Your downloaded content is stored, but if your device runs out of space or you haven't returned for a while, the browser may clear it.

text: 安装此应用有助于保留这些内容。
english: Installing the app helps keep it.
back: Installing this app helps to preserve these contents.

text: 我已阅读并同意服务条款和隐私政策，包括其中关于课堂与教育用途以及 FERPA 的章节。
english: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy, including the sections on classroom and educational use and on FERPA.
back: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, including the sections on Classroom and Educational Use and FERPA.

text: 想玩一局？立体剧场会把整场对决搬进你的头显。
english: Want to play? The Theatre stages the whole duel in your headset.
back: Want to play a game? The 3D theatre brings the entire match into your head.

text: Учителя создают классы, дают викторины и испытания по Шекспиру и следят за успехами учеников.
english: Teachers create classrooms, set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Teachers create classes, give quizzes and tests on Shakespeare, and monitor the progress of students.

text: Создай класс или присоединись к готовому. Учителя дают викторины и испытания по Шекспиру и следят за успехами учеников.
english: Create or join a classroom. Teachers set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Create a class or join an existing one. Teachers give quizzes and tests on Shakespeare and monitor the progress of students.

text: Режим класса создан для школ. Выбери свою роль, чтобы продолжить.
english: Classroom Mode is made for schools. Choose your role to continue.
back: Classroom mode is designed for schools. Choose your role to continue.

english: Join a classroom that already exists

text: Я учитель, преподаватель или представитель администрации школы и имею право пользоваться этим сервисом со своими учениками.
english: I am a teacher, an instructor or a school administrator, and I am authorised to use this with my students.
back: I am a teacher, lecturer or representative of the school administration and am entitled to use this service with my students.

text: Прежде чем записать ученика младше 18 лет, я получу согласие его родителя или опекуна.
english: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under 18.
back: Before enrolling a student under the age of 18, I will obtain consent from his or her parent or guardian.

text: Прежде чем присоединиться к классу, подтверди следующее:
english: Before you join a classroom, please confirm the following:
back: Before joining a class, please confirm the following:

text: Мой родитель или законный опекун знает, что я пользуюсь Inspired Mile для учёбы, и разрешил это.
english: My parent or legal guardian knows I am using Inspired Mile for schoolwork and has given permission.
back: My parent or legal guardian knows that I am using Inspired Mile for educational purposes and has allowed me to do so.

english: My teacher has given me a join code for a classroom.
back: The teacher gave me the class code.

text: Я понимаю, что учитель видит мои успехи и то, что я делаю в классе.
english: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and what I do in the classroom.
back: I understand that the teacher sees my progress and what I do in class.

english: Enter a name for the classroom.

text: Ты пока не состоишь ни в одном классе.
english: You have not joined a classroom yet.
back: You're not in any class yet.

english: Sign in to see your classrooms.
back: Log in to see your classes.

text: Выбери «Создать класс» и дай ему название, например «Литература, 9 „Б“» или «Знакомство с Шекспиром». Каждый класс получает свой код из 6 букв.
english: Choose “Create a classroom” and give it a name, such as “Period 3 English” or “Shakespeare 101”. Each classroom gets its own 6-letter join code.
back: Choose "Create Class" and give it a name, for example "Literature, 9 "B"" or "Introduction to Shakespeare". Each class gets its own 6-letter code.

text: Дай ученикам код из 6 букв. Они выбирают «Я ученик или ученица», подтверждают согласие и вводят код. Адрес электронной почты не нужен.
english: Give your students the 6-letter code. They choose “I am a student”, confirm the consent and enter the code. No email address is needed.
back: Give students a 6-letter code. They select “I am a student”, agree and enter the code. An email address is not required.

english: Post it on your learning platform
back: Place it on the learning platform

text: Создавай задания для своего класса: викторину по Шекспиру для проверки знаний, испытания с цитатами, где нужно вставить пропущенные слова, или дуэль строф для творческого письма.
english: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare trivia to check knowledge, quotation challenges to fill in the missing words, or a duel of verses for creative writing.
back: Create assignments for your class: a Shakespeare quiz to test knowledge, a quotation quiz to fill in missing words, or a verse duel for creative writing.

text: 5 вопросов по Шекспиру с выбором ответа
Вставить пропущенные слова в знаменитые цитаты
english: Fill in the missing words of famous quotations
back: Insert missing words in famous quotes

text: Дуэль строф из трёх раундов, которую судит само устройство
english: A three-round duel of verses, judged on the device
back: A three-round stanza duel judged by the device itself

text: Смотри, что выполнил каждый ученик, какой у него счёт и какие карты он заработал. Данные остаются внутри класса: ученик видит свои успехи, а ты видишь успехи всех.
english: See what each student has completed, their scores and the cards they have earned. The data stays inside the classroom: students see their own progress, and you see everyone's.
back: See what each student has done, how much they have scored and which cards they have earned. The data remains within the class: the student sees their progress, and you see everyone's success.

english: Who can see a student's progress

text: Покупай коллекционные карты по Шекспиру и обменивайся ими с другими игроками.
english: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.
back: Buy Shakespeare trading cards and trade them with other players.

text: Покупай карты и обменивайся ими с другими игроками. Выставь на продажу свои дубликаты или найди карты, которых тебе не хватает.
english: Buy and trade cards with other players. Offer your duplicates for sale, or find the cards you are missing.
back: Buy cards and trade them with other players. Put your duplicates up for sale or find cards you're missing.

english: Bought. The card is now yours.
Sign in to see your listings.
back: Log in to see your ads.

english: Cards wanted (card numbers, separated by commas)
back: Cards needed (card numbers separated by a comma)

english: Enter a price of at least 1 credit.
back: Set a price of at least 1 credit.

english: Sign in to create a listing.
back: Log in to create an ad.

text: Участвуй в турнирах по дуэлям строф и борись за титул.
english: Enter tournaments of verse duels and play for the title.
back: Participate in verse duels and fight for the title.

text: Участвуй в организованных состязаниях и покажи, как ты владеешь стихом. Игры на выбывание, круговая система и не только.
english: Enter organised competitions and show your command of verse. Single elimination, round robin and more.
back: Take part in organized competitions and show how you master the verse. Knockout games, round system and more.

text: Выбери турнир, чтобы увидеть его сетку.
english: Choose a tournament to see its bracket.
back: Select a tournament to see its grid.

english: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.

back: Registration for the tournament is accepted.

english: The bracket has not been drawn yet.
back: The grid has not been drawn yet.

text: Повышай уровень сезонного пропуска, чтобы открывать награды в Inspired Mile.
english: Raise the level of your Season Pass to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.
back: Level up your Season Pass to unlock Inspired Mile rewards.

text: Играй в битвы, викторины и испытания, чтобы получать XP. Каждый новый уровень открывает карты, кредиты и титулы.
english: Play battles, trivia and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.
back: Play battles, quizzes and trials to earn XP. Each new level unlocks maps, credits and titles.

text: В этом сезоне пока нет наград.
english: This season has no rewards yet.
back: There are no awards for this season.

text: Войди, чтобы прогресс сезонного пропуска сохранялся на всех устройствах.
english: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on every device.
back: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on all devices.

text: Рассматривай 3D-модели карт: в виде гауссовых сплатов или сеток GLB.
english: Look at the cards' 3D models, as Gaussian splats or as GLB meshes.
back: Consider 3D map models: as Gaussian layers or GLB grids.

text: Рассматривай свои карты как 3D-модели. Переключайся между гауссовым сплатом и сеткой GLB. Тяни, чтобы повернуть модель, и прокручивай, чтобы приблизить.
english: Explore your cards as 3D models. Switch between the Gaussian splat and the GLB mesh. Drag to turn the model, scroll to zoom.
back: Think of your maps as 3D models. Switch between Gaussian and GLB grids. Drag to rotate the model, scroll to zoom in.

english: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.

text: Файл hamlet.ply загружен. Тяни, чтобы повернуть, и прокручивай, чтобы приблизить.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: Hamlet.ply is loaded. Drag to rotate and scroll to zoom in.

text: Файл hamlet.ply загружен в пониженном качестве. Тяни, чтобы повернуть, и прокручивай, чтобы приблизить.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply at reduced quality. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: The hamlet.ply file is loaded in reduced quality. Drag to rotate and scroll to zoom in.

text: Качество изображения снижено, чтобы движение оставалось плавным.
english: Picture quality was lowered to keep the movement smooth.
back: The image quality is reduced to keep the movement smooth.

text: Для карты Hamlet нет модели GLB.
english: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
back: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
There is no model in the file.

english: The model could not be loaded.
The GLB view could not be loaded.

text: Гауссовы сплаты, которые рисует Babylon.js. Поворачивай, приближай и двигай реалистичное 3D-изображение модели.
english: Gaussian splats drawn by Babylon.js. Turn, zoom and move around a lifelike 3D picture of the model.
back: Gaussian payoffs drawn by Babylon.js. Rotate, zoom in and move a realistic 3D image of the model.

text: Обычная сетка, показанная через model-viewer. На телефоне она может поставить модель в твоей комнате в дополненной реальности.
english: An ordinary mesh shown with model-viewer. On a phone it can place the model in your room in augmented reality.
back: Ordinary grid shown through model-viewer. On the phone it can put a model in your room in augmented reality.

text: В режиме GLB на телефоне нажми «Смотреть в AR», чтобы увидеть карту в своей комнате.
english: In the GLB view on a phone, tap “View in AR” to see the card in your room.
back: In GLB mode on your phone, tap “View in AR” to see the map in your room.

text: Пройдись по своей коллекции карт по Шекспиру в виртуальной реальности.
english: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.
back: Walk through your collection of Shakespeare maps in virtual reality.

text: Пройдись по своей коллекции в 3D. Она работает на Quest 3 и Vision Pro через WebXR, а на компьютере управляется мышью.
english: Walk through your collection in 3D. It works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro through WebXR, and with a mouse on a computer.
back: Walk through your collection in 3D. It runs on Quest 3 and Vision Pro via WebXR, and is controlled by a mouse on the computer.

text: 3D-галерея загружена. Тяни, чтобы осмотреться, и прокручивай, чтобы приблизить.
english: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: The 3D gallery is loaded. Swipe to view and scroll to zoom in.

text: VR-шлем не найден. Галерея показана в 3D.
english: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.
back: No VR headset found. Gallery is shown in 3D.

text: Нажми кнопку VR в углу изображения.
english: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
back: Press the VR button in the corner of the image.
The 3D gallery could not be started.

text: WebXR недоступен на этом устройстве. Галерея показана в 3D: тяни, чтобы осмотреться, и прокручивай, чтобы приблизить.
english: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: WebXR is not available on this device. Gallery displayed in 3D: drag to view and scroll to zoom.

text: Зажми кнопку мыши и тяни, чтобы осмотреться. Прокручивай, чтобы приблизить. Нажми на карту, чтобы выбрать её.
english: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click a card to select it.
back: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom in. Click on a map to select it.

text: Нажми «Войти в VR», чтобы оказаться внутри. Контроллерами можно перемещаться и выбирать карты.
english: Press “Enter VR” to step inside. Use the controllers to move and to pick cards.
back: Press “Enter VR” to get inside. The controllers can be used to move and select maps.

text: Открывается в WebXR. Посмотри на карту и сожми пальцы, чтобы выбрать её.
english: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select it.
back: Opens in WebXR. Look at the map and pinch to select it.

text: Не удалось связаться с сервером. Проверь соединение и попробуй ещё раз.
english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
back: Could not connect to the server. Please check your connection and try again.

text: У тебя нет на это прав.
english: You are not allowed to do that.
back: You don't have the right to do that.

text: Это только что изменилось. Обнови страницу и попробуй ещё раз.
english: That has just changed. Refresh and try again.
back: This has just changed. Refresh the page and try again.

text: Не получилось. Проверь введённые данные и попробуй ещё раз.
english: That did not go through. Check what you entered and try again.
back: Failed. Please check your input and try again.

text: Слишком много запросов. Подожди минуту и попробуй ещё раз.
english: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
back: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.

text: Что-то пошло не так на нашей стороне. Попробуй ещё раз.
english: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
back: Something went wrong on our side.

text: Сервис сейчас недоступен. Попробуй ещё раз чуть позже.
english: The service is not available right now. Please try again shortly.
back: The service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

text: Что-то пошло не так. Попробуй ещё раз.
english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
back: Something went wrong, please try again.

text: Этого ключа доступа нет в этой учётной записи.
english: That passkey was not found on this account.
back: This access key is not in this account.

text: В названии класса должно быть от 1 до 128 символов.
english: A classroom name must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The class name must contain between 1 and 128 characters.

text: Такой код класса не подходит. В коде 6 букв.
english: That is not a valid join code. It has 6 letters.
back: This class code is not suitable. The code has 6 letters.

text: Класса с таким кодом нет. Уточни код у учителя.
english: No classroom has that code. Check it with your teacher.
back: There is no class with this code. Ask the teacher for the code.

text: Ты не состоишь в этом классе.
english: You are not a member of this classroom.
back: You don't fit in this class.

english: Only the teacher can create assignments.
back: Only the teacher can create assignments.

text: В названии задания должно быть от 1 до 128 символов.
english: An assignment title must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The task name must contain between 1 and 128 characters.

english: That is not a valid card.

text: Цена должна быть от 1 до 100 000 кредитов.
english: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.
back: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.

english: You do not own this card.
That listing is no longer open.
back: This ad has already been closed.

text: Нельзя купить карту по собственному объявлению.
english: You cannot buy your own listing.
back: It is not possible to buy a card on your own ad.

english: Registration for this tournament is closed.
back: Registration for this tournament is closed.

text: В этом турнире больше нет мест.
back: There are no more seats available in this tournament.

english: That match has already been decided.
back: The outcome of this match is already decided.

english: No season is running right now.
You have not reached that level yet.
back: That level has not yet been reached.

english: That reward has already been claimed.
back: This award has already been awarded.

english: You do not have enough credits.
back: There is a lack of credit.

text: Исчерпан сегодняшний лимит трат для игроков младше 18 лет.
english: You have reached today's spending limit for players under 18.
back: Today's spending limit for players under 18 has been exceeded.

english: You have already unlocked that variant.
That is not a valid invitation code.
back: This invitation code is not valid.
There is no invitation with this code.

english: You cannot use your own invitation code.
back: You cannot use your own invitation code.

text: Эту часть страницы не удалось показать.
english: This part of the page could not be shown.
back: This part of the page could not be displayed.

text: Некоторым частям игры нужен интернет. Проверь соединение и попробуй ещё раз.
english: Some parts of the game need an internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
back: Some parts of the game require an internet connection. Check your connection and try again.

english: Sonnet Man: the duel of verses

text: Карточная игра по Шекспиру в духе рэп-баттла от Inspired Mile. Разыгрывай карты, держи форму и напиши лучше соперника, который работает целиком на твоём устройстве.
english: A Shakespeare rap-battle card game from Inspired Mile. Play your cards, keep the form, and out-write an opponent that runs entirely on your device.
back: Inspired Mile's rap battle-style Shakespeare card game. Play cards, stay in shape and write better than your opponent, all running on your device.

text: Приложение открывается на весь экран, и у установленного приложения браузер гораздо реже удаляет загруженную модель.
english: It opens full screen, and an installed app is far less likely to have a downloaded model cleared by the browser.
back: The application opens in full screen, and with the installed application, the browser removes the loaded model much less often.

text: На iPhone и iPad приложение с экрана «Домой» ничего не делит с этой вкладкой. Добавь его до того, как войдёшь или загрузишь модель, иначе придётся делать и то и другое дважды.
english: On iPhone and iPad the Home Screen app shares nothing with this tab. Add it before you sign in or download a model, or you will do both twice.
back: On iPhone and iPad, the app from the Home screen does not share anything with this tab. Add it before you log in or load a model, otherwise you will have to do both twice.

text: Сохранено на этом устройстве: 1,1 ГБ. Браузер не удалит это сам.
english: 1.1 GB kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: Saved on this device: 1.1 GB. The browser will not delete it itself.

text: Загруженное сохранено на этом устройстве. Браузер не удалит его сам.
english: Your download is kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: The download is saved on this device. The browser will not delete it itself.

text: Хранится на этом устройстве: 1,1 ГБ. Но браузер может это удалить, если на устройстве не хватит места или ты долго не будешь заходить.
english: 1.1 GB stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: Stored on this device: 1.1 GB. But the browser can delete it if your device runs out of space or you don't log in for a long time.

text: Загруженное хранится на устройстве, но браузер может его удалить, если на устройстве не хватит места или ты долго не будешь заходить.
english: Your download is stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: Your downloads are stored on your device, but the browser can delete them if you run out of space or don’t log in for a long time.

english: Installing the app helps keep it.
back: The installed app helps save this.

text: Мне известны и я принимаю документы: Условия использования и Политика конфиденциальности, включая разделы об использовании в классе и в учебных целях и о законе FERPA.
english: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy, including the sections on classroom and educational use and on FERPA.
back: I have read and agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, including sections on Classroom and Educational Use and FERPA.

text: Хочется сыграть? Театр ставит всю дуэль прямо в твоём шлеме.
english: Want to play? The Theatre stages the whole duel in your headset.
back: The theatre puts the whole duel right in your helmet.

text: Nauczyciele tworzą klasy, zadają quizy i wyzwania o Szekspirze i śledzą postępy uczniów.
english: Teachers create classrooms, set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Teachers create classes, ask quizzes and challenges about Shakespeare, and track students’ progress.

text: Utwórz klasę albo dołącz do istniejącej. Nauczyciele zadają quizy i wyzwania o Szekspirze i śledzą postępy uczniów.
english: Create or join a classroom. Teachers set Shakespeare trivia and challenges, and follow their students' progress.
back: Create a class or join an existing one.Teachers take quizzes and challenges about Shakespeare and track students’ progress.

text: Tryb klasowy jest przeznaczony dla szkół. Wybierz swoją rolę, aby przejść dalej.
english: Classroom Mode is made for schools. Choose your role to continue.
back: Classroom mode is designed for schools. Choose your role to go further.

english: Join a classroom that already exists

text: Jestem nauczycielem, instruktorem albo członkiem dyrekcji szkoły i mam prawo korzystać z tej usługi z moimi uczniami.
english: I am a teacher, an instructor or a school administrator, and I am authorised to use this with my students.
back: I am a teacher, instructor or member of the school board and am eligible to use this service with my students.

text: Przed zapisaniem ucznia, który nie ma 18 lat, uzyskam zgodę jego rodzica lub opiekuna.
english: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under 18.
back: Before enrolling a student who is under 18, I will obtain the consent of their parent or guardian.

text: Zanim dołączysz do klasy, potwierdź, że:
english: Before you join a classroom, please confirm the following:
back: Before joining the class, confirm that:

text: Mój rodzic lub opiekun prawny wie, że korzystam z Inspired Mile do nauki szkolnej, i wyraził na to zgodę.
english: My parent or legal guardian knows I am using Inspired Mile for schoolwork and has given permission.
back: My parent or legal guardian knows that I am using Inspired Mile for school and has given their consent.

text: Mam od nauczyciela kod dołączenia do klasy.
english: My teacher has given me a join code for a classroom.
back: I got a class code from my teacher.

text: Rozumiem, że nauczyciel widzi moje postępy i to, co robię w klasie.
english: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and what I do in the classroom.
back: I understand that the teacher sees my progress and what I am doing in class.
Enter the joining code with 6 letters.
