You are now in the class "Verona".

english: Enter a name for the classroom.

text: Nie należysz jeszcze do żadnej klasy.
english: You have not joined a classroom yet.
back: You do not belong to any class yet.

text: Zaloguj się, aby zobaczyć swoje klasy.
english: Sign in to see your classrooms.
back: Log in to see your classes.

text: Wybierz „Utwórz klasę” i nadaj jej nazwę, na przykład „Język angielski, klasa 2b” albo „Szekspir na początek”. Każda klasa dostaje własny kod dołączenia z 6 liter.
english: Choose “Create a classroom” and give it a name, such as “Period 3 English” or “Shakespeare 101”. Each classroom gets its own 6-letter join code.
back: Choose “Create class” and give it a name, for example “English, Grade 2b” or “Shakespeare for Beginners”.Each class gets its own 6-letter joining code.

text: Podaj uczniom kod z 6 liter. Wybierają „Jestem uczniem lub uczennicą”, potwierdzają zgodę i wpisują kod. Adres e-mail nie jest potrzebny.
english: Give your students the 6-letter code. They choose “I am a student”, confirm the consent and enter the code. No email address is needed.
back: Give students a 6-letter code. They select “I’m a student”, agree and enter the code. An email address is not required.

english: Post it on your learning platform
back: Publish it on an educational platform

text: Twórz zadania dla swojej klasy: quiz o Szekspirze sprawdzający wiedzę, wyzwania z cytatami, w których trzeba uzupełnić brakujące słowa, albo pojedynek na strofy jako ćwiczenie z twórczego pisania.
english: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare trivia to check knowledge, quotation challenges to fill in the missing words, or a duel of verses for creative writing.
back: Create assignments for your class: a Shakespeare quiz to test your knowledge, quote challenges to fill in missing words, or a verse duel as a creative writing exercise.

text: Uzupełnianie brakujących słów w słynnych cytatach
english: Fill in the missing words of famous quotations
back: Completing missing words in famous quotes

text: Pojedynek na strofy w trzech rundach, oceniany na urządzeniu
english: A three-round duel of verses, judged on the device
back: Duel on stanzas in three rounds, evaluated on the device

text: Sprawdzaj, co ukończył każdy uczeń, jakie ma wyniki i jakie karty zdobył. Dane zostają w klasie: uczeń widzi własne postępy, a ty widzisz postępy wszystkich.
english: See what each student has completed, their scores and the cards they have earned. The data stays inside the classroom: students see their own progress, and you see everyone's.
back: The data stays in the classroom: the student can see their own progress, and you can see everyone else’s progress.

english: Who can see a student's progress

text: Kupuj karty kolekcjonerskie z Szekspirem i wymieniaj się nimi z innymi graczami.
english: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.
back: Buy Shakespeare trading cards and trade them with other players.

text: Kupuj karty i wymieniaj się nimi z innymi graczami. Wystaw swoje duplikaty na sprzedaż albo znajdź karty, których ci brakuje.
english: Buy and trade cards with other players. Offer your duplicates for sale, or find the cards you are missing.
back: Buy cards and trade them with other players, put your duplicates up for sale or find the cards you're missing.

english: Bought. The card is now yours.

text: Zaloguj się, aby zobaczyć swoje oferty.
english: Sign in to see your listings.
back: Log in to see your offers.

english: Cards wanted (card numbers, separated by commas)
back: Searching cards (card numbers separated by commas)

english: Enter a price of at least 1 credit.
Sign in to create a listing.
back: Log in to create an offer.

text: Bierz udział w turniejach pojedynków na strofy i graj o tytuł.
english: Enter tournaments of verse duels and play for the title.
back: Take part in stanza duels tournaments and play for the title.

text: Bierz udział w zorganizowanych rozgrywkach i pokaż, jak władasz wierszem. System pucharowy, każdy z każdym i nie tylko.
english: Enter organised competitions and show your command of verse. Single elimination, round robin and more.
back: Take part in organized competitions and show how you master the poetry.Cup system, everyone against everyone and more.

text: Wybierz turniej, aby zobaczyć jego drabinkę.
english: Choose a tournament to see its bracket.
back: Select a tournament to see its leaderboard.

text: Nie ma jeszcze turniejów. Zajrzyj wkrótce.
english: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.
back: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.
You've got a place in the tournament.

english: The bracket has not been drawn yet.
back: The ladder has not been drawn yet.

text: Podnoś poziom karnetu sezonowego, aby odblokować nagrody w Inspired Mile.
english: Raise the level of your Season Pass to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.
back: Level up your Season Pass to unlock Inspired Mile rewards.

text: Graj w bitwy, quizy i wyzwania, aby zdobywać XP. Każdy nowy poziom odblokowuje karty, kredyty i tytuły.
english: Play battles, trivia and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.
back: Play battles, quizzes and challenges to earn XP, with each new level unlocking cards, credits and titles.

text: Ten sezon nie ma jeszcze nagród.
english: This season has no rewards yet.
back: There are no awards for this season.

text: Zaloguj się, aby zachować postępy karnetu sezonowego na wszystkich urządzeniach.
english: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on every device.
back: Sign in to save your season pass progress on all devices.

text: Oglądaj modele 3D kart jako splaty gaussowskie albo siatki GLB.
english: Look at the cards' 3D models, as Gaussian splats or as GLB meshes.
back: View 3D map models as Gaussian layers or GLB grids.

text: Oglądaj swoje karty jako modele 3D. Przełączaj między splatem gaussowskim a siatką GLB. Przeciągnij, aby obrócić model, i przewiń, aby przybliżyć.
english: Explore your cards as 3D models. Switch between the Gaussian splat and the GLB mesh. Drag to turn the model, scroll to zoom.
back: View your maps as 3D models. Switch between Gaussian weave and GLB grid. Drag to rotate the model, and scroll to zoom in.

english: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.
back: The 3D viewer is ready. Select a tab.

text: Wczytano hamlet.ply. Przeciągnij, aby obrócić, i przewiń, aby przybliżyć.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: Loaded hamlet.ply. Drag to rotate and scroll to zoom in.

text: Wczytano hamlet.ply w obniżonej jakości. Przeciągnij, aby obrócić, i przewiń, aby przybliżyć.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply at reduced quality. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: Loaded hamlet.ply in reduced quality. Drag to rotate and scroll to zoom.

text: Jakość obrazu została obniżona, aby ruch pozostał płynny.
english: Picture quality was lowered to keep the movement smooth.
back: The image quality has been reduced to keep the movement smooth.

text: Nie ma modelu GLB dla karty Hamlet.
english: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
back: There is no GLB model for Hamlet card.
The file does not contain any model.

english: The model could not be loaded.

back: The 3D viewer could not be started.

text: Nie udało się wczytać widoku GLB.
english: The GLB view could not be loaded.
back: Failed to load the GLB view.

text: Splaty gaussowskie rysowane przez Babylon.js. Obracaj, przybliżaj i przesuwaj realistyczny obraz 3D modelu.
english: Gaussian splats drawn by Babylon.js. Turn, zoom and move around a lifelike 3D picture of the model.
back: Gaussian flats drawn by Babylon.js. Rotate, zoom and move a realistic 3D view of the model.

text: Zwykła siatka wyświetlana przez model-viewer. Na telefonie może ustawić model w twoim pokoju w rozszerzonej rzeczywistości.
english: An ordinary mesh shown with model-viewer. On a phone it can place the model in your room in augmented reality.
back: Ordinary grid displayed by model-viewer.On your phone can set the model in your room in augmented reality.

text: W widoku GLB na telefonie dotknij „Zobacz w AR”, aby zobaczyć kartę w swoim pokoju.
english: In the GLB view on a phone, tap “View in AR” to see the card in your room.
back: In the GLB view on your phone, tap “See in AR” to see the card in your room.

text: Przejdź się po swojej kolekcji kart z Szekspirem w wirtualnej rzeczywistości.
english: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.
back: Walk through your collection of Shakespeare cards in virtual reality.

text: Przejdź się po swojej kolekcji w 3D. Działa na Quest 3 i Vision Pro dzięki WebXR oraz z myszą na komputerze.
english: Walk through your collection in 3D. It works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro through WebXR, and with a mouse on a computer.
back: Walk through your collection in 3D.Works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro thanks to WebXR and with a mouse on your computer.

text: Galeria 3D jest wczytana. Przeciągnij, aby się rozejrzeć, i przewiń, aby przybliżyć.
english: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around and scroll to zoom in.

text: Nie znaleziono gogli VR. Galeria jest pokazana w 3D.
english: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.
back: No VR headset found. Gallery is shown in 3D.

text: WebXR jest gotowy. Naciśnij „Wejdź do VR”.
Użyj przycisku VR w rogu obrazu.
english: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
back: Use the VR button in the corner of the image.
The 3D gallery could not be started.

text: WebXR nie jest dostępny na tym urządzeniu. Galeria jest pokazana w 3D: przeciągnij, aby się rozejrzeć, i przewiń, aby przybliżyć.
english: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: WebXR is not available on this device.The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around and scroll to zoom in.

text: Kliknij i przeciągnij, aby się rozejrzeć. Przewiń, aby przybliżyć. Kliknij kartę, aby ją wybrać.
english: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click a card to select it.
back: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom in. Click a card to select it.

english: I am a teacher, an instructor or a school administrator, and I am authorised to use this with my students.
back: I am a teacher, instructor or member of a school board and can use this offer with my students.

text: Ich hole die Einwilligung eines Elternteils oder Vormunds ein, bevor ich Schülerinnen oder Schüler unter 18 Jahren aufnehme.
english: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before enrolling any student under 18.
back: I will obtain the consent of a parent or guardian before admitting students under 18.

text: Bevor du einer Klasse beitrittst, bestätige bitte Folgendes:
english: Before you join a classroom, please confirm the following:
back: Before joining a class, please confirm the following:

text: Ein Elternteil oder mein gesetzlicher Vormund weiß, dass ich Inspired Mile für die Schule nutze, und hat es erlaubt.
english: My parent or legal guardian knows I am using Inspired Mile for schoolwork and has given permission.
back: A parent or legal guardian knows that I am using Inspired Mile for school and has allowed me to do so.

text: Meine Lehrkraft hat mir einen Beitrittscode für eine Klasse gegeben.
english: My teacher has given me a join code for a classroom.
back: My teacher has given me a joining code for a class.

text: Mir ist klar, dass meine Lehrkraft meinen Lernstand und meine Aktivitäten in der Klasse sehen kann.
english: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and what I do in the classroom.
back: I understand that my teacher can see my progress and activities in the class.

text: Gib den Beitrittscode mit 6 Buchstaben ein.
Gib einen Namen für die Klasse ein.
english: Enter a name for the classroom.
back: Enter a name for the class.

text: Du bist noch keiner Klasse beigetreten.
english: You have not joined a classroom yet.
back: You have not joined any class yet.

text: Melde dich an, um deine Klassen zu sehen.
english: Sign in to see your classrooms.
back: Sign in to see your classes.

text: Wähle „Klasse anlegen“ und gib ihr einen Namen, zum Beispiel „Englisch 9b“ oder „Shakespeare für Einsteiger“. Jede Klasse bekommt einen eigenen Beitrittscode mit 6 Buchstaben.
english: Choose “Create a classroom” and give it a name, such as “Period 3 English” or “Shakespeare 101”. Each classroom gets its own 6-letter join code.
back: Choose “Create class” and give it a name, for example “English 9b” or “Shakespeare for beginners”.Each class gets its own 6-letter joining code.

text: Gib deinen Schülerinnen und Schülern den Code mit 6 Buchstaben. Sie wählen „Ich bin Schülerin oder Schüler“, bestätigen die Einwilligung und geben den Code ein. Eine E-Mail-Adresse ist nicht nötig.
english: Give your students the 6-letter code. They choose “I am a student”, confirm the consent and enter the code. No email address is needed.
back: Give your students the 6-letter code. They select “I am a student”, confirm their consent and enter the code, an email address is not required.

english: Post it on your learning platform
back: Setting up on the learning platform

text: Lege Aufgaben für deine Klasse an: ein Shakespeare-Quiz zur Wissensabfrage, Zitat-Herausforderungen mit Lücken zum Ergänzen oder ein Strophenduell für kreatives Schreiben.
english: Create assignments for your class: Shakespeare trivia to check knowledge, quotation challenges to fill in the missing words, or a duel of verses for creative writing.
back: Create assignments for your class: a Shakespeare quiz to check your knowledge, quotation challenges with gaps to fill in, or a strop neck for creative writing.

text: Fehlende Wörter in berühmten Zitaten ergänzen
english: Fill in the missing words of famous quotations
back: Completing missing words in famous quotes

text: Ein Strophenduell über drei Runden, auf dem Gerät bewertet
english: A three-round duel of verses, judged on the device
back: A strap sleeve over three rounds, rated on the device

text: Sieh, was jede Schülerin und jeder Schüler erledigt hat, welche Wertungen erreicht und welche Karten verdient wurden. Die Daten bleiben in der Klasse: Schülerinnen und Schüler sehen ihren eigenen Lernstand, du siehst den aller.
english: See what each student has completed, their scores and the cards they have earned. The data stays inside the classroom: students see their own progress, and you see everyone's.
back: See what each student has done, what scores they have achieved and which cards they’ve earned. The data stays in the classroom. Students see their own progress, you see everyone else’s.

text: Wer den Lernstand einer Schülerin oder eines Schülers sehen kann
english: Who can see a student's progress
back: Who can see the progress of a student

text: Kaufe und tausche Shakespeare-Sammelkarten mit anderen Spielern.
english: Buy and trade Shakespeare collectible cards with other players.
back: Buy and trade Shakespeare Trading Cards with other players.

english: Buy and trade cards with other players. Offer your duplicates for sale, or find the cards you are missing.
back: Buy and trade cards with other players, offer your duplicate cards or find the ones you are missing.

text: Melde dich an, um Karten zu kaufen.
Gekauft. Die Karte gehört jetzt dir.
english: Bought. The card is now yours.
back: Bought. The card is now yours.

text: Melde dich an, um deine Angebote zu sehen.
english: Sign in to see your listings.
back: Sign in to see your listings.

english: Cards wanted (card numbers, separated by commas)
back: Searched cards (card numbers, separated by commas)

text: Gib einen Preis von mindestens 1 Credit ein.
english: Enter a price of at least 1 credit.
back: Enter a price of at least 1 credit.

text: Melde dich an, um ein Angebot zu erstellen.
english: Sign in to create a listing.
back: Sign in to create a quote.

text: Nimm an Turnieren im Strophenduell teil und spiel um den Titel.
english: Enter tournaments of verse duels and play for the title.
back: Participate in tournaments in Strophenduell and play for the title.

text: Nimm an organisierten Wettbewerben teil und zeig, wie gut du Verse beherrschst. K.‑o.‑System, jeder gegen jeden und mehr.
english: Enter organised competitions and show your command of verse. Single elimination, round robin and more.
back: Take part in organised competitions and show how good you are at verse, knockout system, one-on-one and more.
was: Nimm an organisierten Wettbewerben teil und zeig, wie gut du Verse beherrschst. K.-o.-System, jeder gegen jeden und mehr.

english: Choose a tournament to see its bracket.
back: Select a tournament to see its tournament tree.

english: There are no tournaments yet. Check back soon.
back: There are no tournaments yet, please check back soon.
You take part in the tournament.

english: The bracket has not been drawn yet.
back: The tournament tree has not been drawn yet.

text: Steigere die Stufe deines Saisonpasses und schalte Belohnungen in Inspired Mile frei.
english: Raise the level of your Season Pass to unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.
back: Level up your Season Pass and unlock rewards in Inspired Mile.

text: Spiel Kämpfe, Quiz und Herausforderungen, um XP zu sammeln. Jede neue Stufe schaltet Karten, Credits und Titel frei.
english: Play battles, trivia and challenges to earn XP. Each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.
back: Play battles, quizzes and challenges to earn XP; each new level unlocks cards, credits and titles.

text: Noch 150 XP bis zur nächsten Stufe
Für diese Saison gibt es noch keine Belohnungen.
english: This season has no rewards yet.
back: There are no rewards for this season yet.

text: Melde dich an, damit dein Saisonpass-Fortschritt auf allen Geräten erhalten bleibt.
english: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on every device.
back: Sign in to keep your Season Pass progress on all devices.

text: Sieh dir die 3D-Modelle der Karten an, als Gaussian Splats oder als GLB-Meshes.
english: Look at the cards' 3D models, as Gaussian splats or as GLB meshes.
back: View the 3D models of the maps, as Gaussian Splats or as GLB meshes.

english: Explore your cards as 3D models. Switch between the Gaussian splat and the GLB mesh. Drag to turn the model, scroll to zoom.
back: Explore your maps as 3D models. Switch between Gaussian Splat and GLB Mesh, drag to rotate the model and scroll to zoom.

text: Der 3D-Betrachter ist bereit. Wähle eine Karte.
english: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a card.
back: The 3D viewer is ready. Choose a map.

text: hamlet.ply wurde geladen. Zieh, um es zu drehen, und scrolle zum Zoomen.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: hamlet.ply has been loaded, drag to rotate and scroll to zoom.

text: hamlet.ply wurde in verringerter Qualität geladen. Zieh, um es zu drehen, und scrolle zum Zoomen.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply at reduced quality. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: hamlet.ply was loaded in reduced quality, drag to rotate and scroll to zoom.

text: Die Bildqualität wurde verringert, damit die Bewegung flüssig bleibt.
english: Picture quality was lowered to keep the movement smooth.
back: The image quality has been reduced to keep the movement smooth.

english: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
back: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
The file does not contain a model.

english: The model could not be loaded.
back: The model could not be loaded.

english: The GLB view could not be loaded.
back: The GLB view could not be loaded

back: Gaussian Splats, rendered with Babylon.js. Rotate, zoom and move a realistic 3D image of the model.

english: An ordinary mesh shown with model-viewer. On a phone it can place the model in your room in augmented reality.
back: An ordinary mesh, displayed with model-viewer.On the phone it can put the model in augmented reality in your room.

english: In the GLB view on a phone, tap “View in AR” to see the card in your room.
back: Tap “View in AR” from the GLB view on your phone to see the map in your room.

text: Geh in der virtuellen Realität durch deine Shakespeare-Kartensammlung.
english: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.
back: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.

text: Geh in 3D durch deine Sammlung. Sie läuft über WebXR auf Quest 3 und Vision Pro und mit der Maus am Computer.
english: Walk through your collection in 3D. It works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro through WebXR, and with a mouse on a computer.
back: Walk through your collection in 3D, running via WebXR on Quest 3 and Vision Pro and with the mouse on your computer.

text: Die 3D-Galerie ist geladen. Zieh, um dich umzusehen, und scrolle zum Zoomen.
english: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: The 3D gallery is loaded, swipe to look around and scroll to zoom.

text: Kein VR-Headset gefunden. Die Galerie wird in 3D gezeigt.
english: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.
back: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.

text: WebXR ist bereit. Drück auf „VR starten“.
Nutze den VR-Knopf in der Ecke des Bildes.
english: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
back: Use the VR button in the corner of the image.

text: WebXR ist auf diesem Gerät nicht verfügbar. Die Galerie wird in 3D gezeigt: Zieh, um dich umzusehen, und scrolle zum Zoomen.
english: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: WebXR is not available on this device.The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around and scroll to zoom.

english: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click a card to select it.
back: Click and drag to look around, scroll to zoom, and click on a map to select it.

english: Press “Enter VR” to step inside. Use the controllers to move and to pick cards.
back: Press “Start VR” to enter, then use the controllers to move and select maps.

english: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select it.
back: Opens in WebXR. View a map and pinch to select it.

back: You've reached today's spending limit for players under 18.

back: You have already unlocked this variant.

english: Sonnet Man: the duel of verses
back: Sonnet Man: The Duel of Verses

english: A Shakespeare rap-battle card game from Inspired Mile. Play your cards, keep the form, and out-write an opponent that runs entirely on your device.
back: A Shakespearean card game in the style of battle rap, by Inspired Mile.Play your cards, stay in shape and write better than an opponent running all on your device.

english: It opens full screen, and an installed app is far less likely to have a downloaded model cleared by the browser.
back: The app opens in full screen, and with an installed app it is much less likely that the browser will delete a downloaded model.

english: On iPhone and iPad the Home Screen app shares nothing with this tab. Add it before you sign in or download a model, or you will do both twice.
back: On iPhone and iPad, the app on your home screen doesn't share anything with this tab, so add it before you sign in or download a model, otherwise you'll have to do both twice.

english: Your download is kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: Your download is permanently stored on this device; your browser won't delete it by itself.

back: Stored on this device: 1.1 GB, but your browser can delete it if the device is running low on memory or you haven't checked in for a while.

back: Your download is saved, but your browser may delete it if your device is running low on memory or you haven't checked in for a while.

back: An installed app helps to keep the data.

back: I have read and agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Statement, including the sections on Classroom and Educational Use and FERPA.

back: Feel like playing? The Theatre brings the whole duel into your headset.

back: Teachers create classes, give quizzes and challenges on Shakespeare and track their students’ progress.

back: Create or join a class where teachers give quizzes and challenges on Shakespeare and track their students’ progress.

back: Classroom Mode is designed for schools. Choose your role to continue.

english: Join a classroom that already exists

back: I am a teacher, trainer or member of the school board and I am authorized to use this service with my students.

back: Before joining a class, please confirm the following:

back: My parent or legal guardian knows that I am using Inspired Mile for my school work and has given me permission to do so.

text: Se ha cargado hamlet.ply con calidad reducida. Arrastra para girarlo y usa la rueda para acercarlo.
english: Loaded hamlet.ply at reduced quality. Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom.
back: hamlet.ply has been loaded with reduced quality, drag to rotate and use the wheel to zoom in.

text: Se ha bajado la calidad de imagen para que el movimiento sea fluido.
english: Picture quality was lowered to keep the movement smooth.
back: The image quality has been lowered to make the movement smooth.

text: No hay modelo GLB para Hamlet.
english: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.
back: There is no GLB model for Hamlet.

text: El archivo no contiene ningún modelo.
back: The file does not contain any template.

text: No se ha podido cargar el modelo.
english: The model could not be loaded.
back: The model could not be loaded.

text: El visor 3D no ha podido iniciarse.
back: The 3D viewer could not be started.

text: No se ha podido cargar la vista GLB.
english: The GLB view could not be loaded.
back: Could not load the GLB view.

text: Splats gaussianos dibujados con Babylon.js. Gira, acerca y desplaza una imagen 3D realista del modelo.
english: Gaussian splats drawn by Babylon.js. Turn, zoom and move around a lifelike 3D picture of the model.
back: Gaussian flats drawn with Babylon.js. Rotate, zoom and pan a realistic 3D image of the model.

text: Una malla corriente mostrada con model-viewer. En un móvil puede colocar el modelo en tu habitación con realidad aumentada.
english: An ordinary mesh shown with model-viewer. On a phone it can place the model in your room in augmented reality.
back: A current mesh displayed with model-viewer.On a mobile you can place the model in your room with augmented reality.

text: En la vista GLB de un móvil, toca «Ver en RA» para ver la carta en tu habitación.
english: In the GLB view on a phone, tap “View in AR” to see the card in your room.
back: In a mobile GLB view, tap “View in AR” to see the menu in your room.

text: Recorre tu colección de cartas de Shakespeare en realidad virtual.
english: Walk through your Shakespeare card collection in virtual reality.
back: Browse your collection of Shakespeare letters in virtual reality.

text: Recorre tu colección en 3D. Funciona en Quest 3 y Vision Pro mediante WebXR, y con ratón en un ordenador.
english: Walk through your collection in 3D. It works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro through WebXR, and with a mouse on a computer.
back: Browse your collection in 3D.Works on Quest 3 and Vision Pro via WebXR, and with mouse on a computer.

text: La galería 3D está cargada. Arrastra para mirar alrededor y usa la rueda para acercarte.
english: The 3D gallery is loaded. Drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: The 3D gallery is loaded, drag to look around and use the wheel to zoom in.

text: No se ha encontrado ningún visor de RV. La galería se muestra en 3D.
english: No VR headset found. The gallery is shown in 3D.
back: No VR viewer found. The gallery is displayed in 3D.

text: WebXR está listo. Pulsa «Entrar en RV».
Usa el botón de RV que hay en la esquina de la imagen.
english: Use the VR button in the corner of the picture.
back: Use the VR button in the corner of the image.

text: La galería 3D no ha podido iniciarse.
back: The 3D gallery could not be started.

text: WebXR no está disponible en este dispositivo. La galería se muestra en 3D: arrastra para mirar alrededor y usa la rueda para acercarte.
english: WebXR is not available on this device. The gallery is shown in 3D: drag to look around, scroll to zoom.
back: WebXR not available on this device.The gallery is displayed in 3D: drag to look around and use the wheel to zoom in.

text: Haz clic y arrastra para mirar alrededor. Usa la rueda para acercarte. Haz clic en una carta para seleccionarla.
english: Click and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Click a card to select it.
back: Click and drag to look around. Use the wheel to zoom in.Click on a card to select it.

text: Pulsa «Entrar en RV» para meterte dentro. Usa los mandos para moverte y elegir cartas.
english: Press “Enter VR” to step inside. Use the controllers to move and to pick cards.
back: Press “Enter VR” to get inside. Use the controllers to move around and pick cards.

text: Se abre en WebXR. Mira una carta y pellizca para seleccionarla.
english: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select it.
back: Opens in WebXR. Look at a card and pinch to select it.

text: No hemos podido conectar con el servidor. Comprueba tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.
english: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
back: We were unable to connect to the server, please check your connection and try again.

text: No tienes permiso para hacer eso.
english: You are not allowed to do that.
back: You don't have permission to do that.

text: Eso acaba de cambiar. Actualiza la página e inténtalo de nuevo.
english: That has just changed. Refresh and try again.
back: That just changed, please refresh the page and try again.

text: No ha salido bien. Revisa lo que has escrito e inténtalo de nuevo.
english: That did not go through. Check what you entered and try again.
back: It didn't work out well, check what you wrote and try again.

text: Demasiadas solicitudes. Espera un minuto e inténtalo de nuevo.
english: Too many requests. Wait a minute, then try again.
back: Too many requests, please wait a minute and try again.

text: Algo ha fallado por nuestra parte. Inténtalo de nuevo.
english: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
back: Something went wrong on our part, please try again.

text: El servicio no está disponible ahora mismo. Inténtalo de nuevo dentro de un momento.
english: The service is not available right now. Please try again shortly.
back: The service is not available right now, please try again in a moment.

text: Algo ha salido mal. Inténtalo de nuevo.
english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
back: Something went wrong, please try again.

text: Esa llave de acceso no está en esta cuenta.
english: That passkey was not found on this account.
back: That passkey is not in this account.

text: El nombre de la clase debe tener entre 1 y 128 caracteres.
english: A classroom name must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The class name must be between 1 and 128 characters.

text: Ese código de acceso no es válido. Tiene 6 letras.
english: That is not a valid join code. It has 6 letters.
back: This access code is not valid. It has 6 letters.

text: Ninguna clase tiene ese código. Compruébalo con tu docente.
english: No classroom has that code. Check it with your teacher.
back: No class has that code, check with your teacher.

text: No eres miembro de esta clase.
english: You are not a member of this classroom.
back: You are not a member of this class.

text: Solo el docente puede crear tareas.
english: Only the teacher can create assignments.
back: Only the teacher can create assignments.

text: El título de la tarea debe tener entre 1 y 128 caracteres.
english: An assignment title must have between 1 and 128 characters.
back: The task title must be between 1 and 128 characters.

english: That is not a valid card.

text: El precio debe estar entre 1 y 100.000 créditos.
english: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.
back: The price must be between 1 and 100,000 credits.

english: You do not own this card.

text: Ese anuncio ya no está abierto.
english: That listing is no longer open.
back: That ad is no longer open.

text: No puedes comprar tu propio anuncio.
english: You cannot buy your own listing.
back: You can't buy your own ad.

text: La inscripción a este torneo está cerrada.
english: Registration for this tournament is closed.
back: Registration for this tournament is closed.

english: That match has already been decided.

text: Ahora mismo no hay ninguna temporada en curso.
english: No season is running right now.
back: There are no seasons in progress right now.

text: Todavía no has alcanzado ese nivel.
english: You have not reached that level yet.
back: You have not reached that level yet.

text: Esa recompensa ya se ha reclamado.
english: That reward has already been claimed.
back: That reward has already been claimed.

english: You do not have enough credits.

text: Has alcanzado el límite de gasto de hoy para jugadores menores de 18 años.
english: You have reached today's spending limit for players under 18.
back: You've reached today's spending limit for players under 18.

english: You have already unlocked that variant.

text: Ese código de invitación no es válido.
english: That is not a valid invitation code.
back: That invitation code is not valid.

text: No puedes usar tu propio código de invitación.
english: You cannot use your own invitation code.
back: You cannot use your own invitation code.

text: No se ha podido mostrar esta parte de la página.
english: This part of the page could not be shown.
back: The page you are looking for could not be found.

text: Algunas partes del juego necesitan conexión a internet. Comprueba tu conexión e inténtalo de nuevo.
english: Some parts of the game need an internet connection. Check your connection and try again.
back: Some parts of the game require an internet connection, please check your connection and try again.

text: Sonnet Man: el duelo de estrofas
english: Sonnet Man: the duel of verses
back: Sonnet Man: The Duel of Verses

text: Un juego de cartas de batallas de rap shakespearianas, de Inspired Mile. Juega tus cartas, respeta la forma y escribe mejor que un rival que funciona por completo en tu dispositivo.
english: A Shakespeare rap-battle card game from Inspired Mile. Play your cards, keep the form, and out-write an opponent that runs entirely on your device.
back: A Shakespearean rap battle card game from Inspired Mile.Play your cards, respect the form and type better than a rival that works fully on your device.

text: Se abre a pantalla completa, y en una app instalada es mucho menos probable que el navegador borre un modelo descargado.
english: It opens full screen, and an installed app is far less likely to have a downloaded model cleared by the browser.
back: It opens in full screen, and on an installed app it is much less likely that the browser will delete a downloaded model.

text: En el iPhone y el iPad, la app de la pantalla de inicio no comparte nada con esta pestaña. Añádela antes de iniciar sesión o descargar un modelo, o tendrás que hacer las dos cosas dos veces.
english: On iPhone and iPad the Home Screen app shares nothing with this tab. Add it before you sign in or download a model, or you will do both twice.
back: On iPhone and iPad, the Home screen app doesn’t share anything with this tab — add it before signing in or downloading a model, or you’ll have to do both twice.

text: Se conservan 1,1 GB en este dispositivo. Tu navegador no los borrará por su cuenta.
english: 1.1 GB kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: 1.1 GB is retained on this device, your browser won't delete it on its own.

text: Tu descarga se conserva en este dispositivo. Tu navegador no la borrará por su cuenta.
english: Your download is kept on this device. Your browser will not clear it on its own.
back: Your download remains on this device; your browser won't delete it on its own.

text: Se han guardado 1,1 GB, pero tu navegador puede borrarlos si el dispositivo se queda sin espacio o si pasas un tiempo sin volver.
english: 1.1 GB stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: 1.1 GB has been saved, but your browser can erase it if your device runs out of space or you don't come back for a while.

text: Tu descarga está guardada, pero tu navegador puede borrarla si el dispositivo se queda sin espacio o si pasas un tiempo sin volver.
english: Your download is stored, but your browser may clear this if the device runs short of space or you stay away for a while.
back: Your download is saved, but your browser can delete it if your device runs out of space or you don't come back for a while.

text: Si instalas la app, es más probable que se conserve.
english: Installing the app helps keep it.
back: If you install the app, it’s more likely to stay.

text: He leído y acepto las Condiciones del servicio y la Política de privacidad, incluidos los apartados sobre el uso en clase y con fines educativos y sobre la FERPA.
english: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy, including the sections on classroom and educational use and on FERPA.
back: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, including the sections on Classroom and Educational Use and FERPA.

text: ¿Quieres jugar? El Teatro pone en escena el duelo completo en tu visor.
english: Want to play? The Theatre stages the whole duel in your headset.
back: Want to play? The Theatre stages the entire duel in your viewfinder.
